source:
The 1968 election enters its final stretch in chaos. Riots are a frequent occurrence as the Vietnam War divides the nation, and Johnson's "Great Society" is under full attack.

  • Nixon attempts to present himself as a law-and-order candidate who will bear the standard of Republicanism.
  • Humphrey tries to hold the line for liberalism in a year of social chaos and racial agitation.
  • Wallace hopes to bring an end to Civil Rights and desegregation.
zh:
1968年总统选举在混乱中进入最后阶段。越南战争使国家分裂，骚乱频频发生，约翰逊的“伟大社会”计划也受到全面攻击。

  • 尼克松力图以维护法律与秩序的候选人形象，扛起共和党的旗帜。
  • 在社会混乱、种族冲突激烈的一年里，汉弗莱试图守住自由派的阵地。
  • 华莱士希望终结民权政策和废除种族隔离的进程。

source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1968 election.

Never has a candidate been so far ahead in a Presidential election, only to come up short. After your heartbreaking loss in 1960, it's going to take a long while for you to recover from this new defeat.

The American public will never know what might have transpired with you in the Oval Office. As it is, you are sure to enjoy a long retirement after this one...
zh:
抱歉，你输掉了 1968 年的选举。

从来没有哪个候选人在总统选举中遥遥领先，却最终落败。在经历了 1960 年令人心碎的失败之后，你需要很长时间才能从这次新的失败中恢复过来。

美国公众永远不会知道你在椭圆形办公室里可能发生了什么。事实上，在这之后你一定会享受漫长的退休生活......

source:
Wow! No candidate holds a majority in the electoral college.

Wallace's machinations have succeeded. The election will go to the House of Representatives where the Democrats hold a clear majority.

You do hold some cards however -- Humphrey would certainly rather make concessions to you, rather than deal with George Wallace. Perhaps you could obtain a place in his Administration, or some assurances on a policy issue of your choice.
zh:
哇！没有候选人在选举人团中占据多数。

华莱士的阴谋得逞了。选举将在众议院进行，民主党在众议院占据绝对多数席位。

不过，你确实握有一些牌——汉弗莱肯定宁愿向你让步，也不愿与乔治·华莱士打交道。也许你可以在他的政府中获得一席之地，或者在你选择的政策问题上获得一些保证。

source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1968 election!

It looked like a hopeless case as you accepted the nomination, but you have run an outstanding campaign in the interval.

Now you must press forward with your efforts to defend the Great Society and to end the war in Vietnam. Failure in the latter case could be devastating when you seek reelection in 1972. After all, just look at what happened to the once-lustrous reputation of Lyndon Johnson over the past four years...
zh:
恭喜！你赢得了 1968 年的选举！

当你接受提名时，这看起来像是一个无望的情况，但你在这段时间里进行了出色的竞选活动。

现在你必须继续努力保卫伟大社会并结束越南战争。当你在 1972 年寻求连任时，后一种情况的失败可能是毁灭性的。毕竟，看看林登·约翰逊曾经辉煌的声誉在过去四年里发生了什么......

source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1968 election.

You may have performed admirably under trying circumstances, but it was always a tough sell for you after the chaos at the Democratic Convention in Chicago.

Your only consolation is that Nixon himself is a former loser. Even so, this is a horrednous turn of events for Democrats after the landslide of 1964. The best you can do now is to plot a comeback to the Senate, or as a candidate for President in 1972.
zh:
抱歉，你输掉了 1968 年的选举。

你可能在艰难的环境下表现得令人钦佩，但在芝加哥民主党代表大会的混乱之后，这对你来说总是一个艰难的推销。

你唯一的安慰是尼克松自己曾经是个失败者。即便如此，对于民主党来说，继 1964 年的压倒性胜利之后，这仍然是一个可怕的转变。你现在能做的最好的事情就是策划重返参议院，或者作为 1972 年的总统候选人。

source:
Wow! No candidate achieved a majority in the electoral college.

Fortunately for you the Democrats have won a majority of the nation's Congressional delegations. Unfortunately, you also have to deal with George Wallace. He will not allow the Southern states to support any candidate who advocates desegregation.

Your best chance, sadly, is to try to broker a deal with Nixon or with other moderate Republicans.

You are the likely winner, but who knows where this all ends?
zh:
哇！没有候选人在选举人团中获得多数票。

对你来说幸运的是，民主党赢得了全国国会代表团的多数席位。不幸的是，您还必须处理乔治·华莱士。他不会允许南方各州支持任何主张废除种族隔离的候选人。

不幸的是，你最好的机会是尝试与尼克松或其他温和的共和党人达成协议。

你可能是赢家，但谁知道这一切的结局是什么？

source:
Wow! You have won the 1968 election in a shocker!

Dixie forever! Even with the Long Hot Summer of 1967, nobody guessed that you could do well enough in the Northern states to win the election outright. You have instantly become most polarizing President-elect since Abraham Lincoln.
zh:
哇！您令人震惊地赢得了 1968 年大选！

永远的迪克西！即使 1967 年漫长炎热的夏季，也没有人想到你能在北部各州表现出色，彻底赢得选举。您立即成为自亚伯拉罕·林肯以来最两极分化的当选总统。

source:
Sorry, you did not prevent an electoral college majority.

You put in a good effort, but your dream of brokering an end to desegregation will not come to fruition in 1968. No winning candidate will negotiate that point with you unless they absolutely have no choice.

The best you can do for now is continue to sound the call for a return to sanity in American politics. Perhaps if the riots and discord continue, you will have a better chance of making your voice heard in 1972.
zh:
抱歉，您没有阻止选举人团多数。

你付出了很大的努力，但你促成废除种族隔离的梦想不会在 1968 年实现。获胜的候选人不会与你谈判这一点，除非他们绝对别无选择。

现在你能做的最好的事情就是继续呼吁美国政治恢复理智。也许如果骚乱和不和继续下去，你将有更好的机会在 1972 年表达你的声音。

source:
Congratulations! You have deadlocked the electoral college with your votes in the South.

In a close election, your electoral votes in the South have prevented either candidate from winning a majority. Get ready to put the squeeze on Humphrey and Nixon.

Of course, you still have to deal with the possibility that Humphrey and Nixon dislike you so much that they will simply strike a deal with each other. Whatever happens, it's sure to be interesting.
zh:
恭喜！你在南方的选票使选举人团陷入僵局。

在一场势均力敌的选举中，你们在南方的选举人票阻止了任何一位候选人赢得多数席位。准备好挤压汉弗莱和尼克松。

当然，你仍然需要面对这样一种可能性：汉弗莱和尼克松非常不喜欢你，以至于他们会简单地互相达成协议。无论发生什么，它肯定会很有趣。

source: * Ha^^ ha^^ ha^^ ha^^^^^^...<^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^* Did you REALLY think it was OVER!?!?<^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^* I mean, we haven't even shown you what happens when Wallace wins every state yet...^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
Sorry, you lost the 1968 election.
zh: 抱歉，你输掉了 1968 年的选举。

source:
Order!

Richard M Nixon, how do you plead on 1 count of treason against the United States of America, 1 count of misappropriation of campaign funds, 1 count of obstruction of justice, one count of abuse of power, one count of…

Richard Nixon, as he heard all this droning from the judge, closed his eyes, waiting for the sentence to end. He had been up all night, unable to sleep due to all the stress from the trial. Before he knew it, he’d fallen unconscious. All of a sudden, he jolted awake to the sound of the judge screaming; "NIXON! What do you plead?..."

"Uh, not guilty, your honour… not guilty?"

"On 1 count of sleeping in a court of law?..."

"When did you say tha- actually yes, your honour. The liberal media has been painting an askew picture of me. I was merely resting my eyes."
zh:
下单！

理查德·M 尼克松，您如何就 1 项叛国罪、1 项挪用竞选资金罪、1 项妨碍司法罪、1 项滥用权力罪、1 项…

理查德·尼克松，当他听到法官的嗡嗡声时，闭上眼睛，等待判决结束。由于审判带来的压力，他彻夜未眠，无法入睡。在他意识到之前，他已经失去知觉了。突然，他被法官的尖叫声惊醒。 “尼克松！你恳求什么？……”

“呃，无罪，法官大人……无罪？”

“还有一项罪名——在法庭上睡觉？……”

“您什么时候说过这——其实是的，法官大人。自由派媒体一直在歪曲我的形象。我只是闭目养神。”

source: Congratulations! You won the 1968 election!
zh: 恭喜！你赢得了 1968 年的选举！

source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. Your performance in debates and campaigning were widely praised compared to 1960, which allowed you to win with a massive landslide. What a turnaround from 1964!
zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士之间发生了激烈的战斗，你还是驳斥了怀疑者并挽回了你的名誉。与1960年相比，你们在辩论和竞选中的表现受到了广泛赞扬，1960年你们以压倒性优势获胜。与 1964 年相比，情况发生了多么大的转变！

source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. Your lead dwindled a bit as Wallace’s appeal dampened, but your coalition managed to remain intact.
zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士之间发生了激烈的战斗，你还是驳斥了怀疑者并挽回了你的名誉。随着华莱士的吸引力减弱，你的领先优势有所缩小，但你的联盟设法保持完整。

source: Congratulations! Despite the intense battle from Humphrey and Wallace, you have disproven the doubters and redeemed your name. The bombing halt and Wallace collapsing in the north nearly lost you the election, but you managed to hang on.
zh: 恭喜！尽管汉弗莱和华莱士之间发生了激烈的战斗，你还是驳斥了怀疑者并挽回了你的名誉。轰炸停止和北部的华莱士倒塌几乎让你失去了选举，但你设法坚持了下来。

source: For the first time since 1888, the winner of the electoral vote lost the popular vote. It seems many people underestimated how much of an effect Wallace had on your campaign in the south.
zh: 自 1888 年以来，选举人票获胜者首次输掉了普选票。看来很多人低估了华莱士对你在南方的竞选活动的影响有多大。

source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 7 of the last 9 presidential elections. With the margins being as close as 8 years ago, you are already having flashbacks of 1960.
zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合尼克松卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人对他们在过去 9 次总统选举中输掉 7 次感到震惊。时间间隔已接近 8 年前，你已经可以回想起 1960 年的情景了。

source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 8 of the last 10 presidential elections. Somehow you managed to do worse compared to 1960. Nobody is quite sure how that is even possible, but suffice it to say you will receive much of the blame.
zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合尼克松卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人感到震惊的是，他们在过去 10 次总统选举中输掉了 8 次。不知何故，与 1960 年相比，你的表现更差了。没有人完全确定这怎么可能，但足以说明你将受到大部分指责。

source: Despite the environment seemingly being perfect for a Nixon comeback, you had a sudden and shocking reversal of fortunes, and have lost yet another presidential election. Republicans are shocked they have now lost 8 of the last 10 presidential elections. Not only did you lose, but you got crushed. Under the weight of two ideologically different candidates, your moderate positions seemed to not appeal. If the skirmish between liberal and conservative republicans wasn’t already bad, it was going to get a lot worse after this.
zh: 尽管环境似乎非常适合尼克松卷土重来，但你的命运突然发生了令人震惊的逆转，并再次输掉了总统选举。共和党人感到震惊的是，他们在过去 10 次总统选举中输掉了 8 次。你不仅输了，还被压垮了。在两位意识形态不同的候选人的压力下，你的温和立场似乎没有吸引力。如果自由派和保守派共和党人之间的冲突还不算严重的话，那么此后情况将会变得更糟。

source: At the end of the day, in possibly the most shocking turn of events, the popular vote fell in your favour. Nobody is sure what to make of this, but maybe the Democrats can use their house and senate supermajorities, combined with disaffected Republicans, to pass electoral reform?
zh: 最终，这可能是最令人震惊的事件，民众投票对你有利。没有人知道该怎么做，但也许民主党可以利用众议院和参议院的绝对多数，再加上心怀不满的共和党人，来通过选举改革？

source: A return to the Senate might be in order, so you might defend liberalism from demise during Nixon's administration, or gearing up for a run in 1972. perhaps you can do both. In any case, let's hope Nixon can cool tensions in America and bring the troops home.
zh: 重返参议院可能是理所当然的，所以你可能会在尼克松执政期间捍卫自由主义免遭灭亡，或者为 1972 年的竞选做准备。也许你可以两者都做。无论如何，我们希望尼克松能够缓和美国的紧张局势并让军队回国。

source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. You still fought hard, and took Nixon to the brink as Kennedy did in 60.
zh: 尽管您在艰难的气候下尽了最大努力，理查德·尼克松仍将成功约翰逊担任总统。在一个分裂的政党中与一个不受欢迎的政府如此密切地联系在一起总是很困难的。你仍然顽强地战斗，并像60年的肯尼迪一样将尼克松带到了悬崖边。

source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. The crime and rioting took a toll on your campaign hard, and Nixon's law and order theme really hit home for many Americans.
zh: 尽管您在艰难的气候下尽了最大努力，理查德·尼克松仍将成功约翰逊担任总统。在一个分裂的政党中与一个不受欢迎的政府如此密切地联系在一起总是很困难的。犯罪和骚乱对您的竞选活动造成了沉重打击，而尼克松的法律与秩序主题对许多美国人来说确实击中了要害。

source: Despite your best efforts in a tough climate, Richard Nixon will succeed Johnson in the presidency. It was always going to be difficult being so closely associated with an unpopular administration, in a divided party. It seems liberalism very well might be over with this loss, as you have been crushed. A more moderate candidate in 4 years will likely be chosen.
zh: 尽管您在艰难的气候下尽了最大努力，理查德·尼克松仍将成功约翰逊担任总统。在一个分裂的政党中与一个不受欢迎的政府如此密切地联系在一起总是很困难的。看来自由主义很可能会因这次损失而结束，因为你已经被压垮了。四年后可能会选择一位更为温和的候选人。

source: Your first course of action is to fix what Johnson caused. Vietnam and the riots need to be dealt with. Johnson might not like how you deal with it, but this is your administration, and you'll deal with it the way you do. Act quickly, or you just might become as unpopular as Johnson.
zh: 您的首要行动是解决约翰逊造成的问题。越南和骚乱需要得到处理。约翰逊可能不喜欢你的处理方式，但这是你的政府，你会按照你的方式处理它。赶快行动，否则你可能会像约翰逊一样不受欢迎。

source: As expected, you lost the 1968 election
zh: 正如所料，你输掉了 1968 年选举

source: What happens next is your choice. Another governorship wouldn't hurt, and perhaps you can run again in 4 years if you're up to it. Unfortunately (for you), civil rights will persist.
zh: 接下来发生的事情是你的选择。再担任州长也没什么坏处，如果你有能力的话，也许四年后你可以再次竞选。不幸的是（对你来说），民权将持续存在。

source: Unbelievable! You won the 1968 election!
zh: 难以置信！你赢得了 1968 年的选举！

source: In a shock to all parties involved, neither Hubert Horatio Humphrey nor Richard Milhous Nixon will be the next president of the United States. Somehow, you managed to come out on top. Southerners are ecstatic, liberals are foaming at the mouth, and the black population has never been more fearful.
zh: 令所有相关方感到震惊的是，休伯特·霍雷肖汉弗莱和理查德·米尔豪斯尼克松都不会成为美国下一任总统。不知何故，你成功地脱颖而出。南方人欣喜若狂，自由主义者口吐白沫，而黑人则从未如此恐惧。

source: Pundits are shocked, trying to figure out how you managed to capture states outside the deep south to win it all. What happens next is entirely unknown. Its likely a crusader against the civil rights bill will happen, as well as the deconstruction of Great Society, and the escalation of Vietnam. Whatever happens, sit back and relax knowing you've done the greatest upset in US political history!
zh: 专家们感到震惊，试图弄清楚你是如何设法占领深南部之外的州并赢得这一切的。接下来会发生什么是完全未知的。很可能会发生针对民权法案的十字军东征，以及伟大社会的解构和越南的升级。无论发生什么，坐下来放松一下，因为你知道你已经造成了美国政治历史上最大的麻烦！

source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You did, however, come very close, picking up a number of states you weren't expected to pick up. It seems that your crusade for the south turned out really well. You could run in four years perhaps, and try and win the same coalition, trying to deadlock the election then. You've sent a clear message to the Democrats; the south isn't to be ignored,
zh: 正如大多数人所预料的那样，你输了。这并不奇怪，因为您是第三方。更糟糕的是，你使选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标失败了。然而，您确实非常接近，选择了一些您不希望选择的州。看来你对南方的征战结果非常好。也许你可以在四年内竞选，并尝试赢得同一个联盟，然后试图使选举陷入僵局。你已经向民主党发出了明确的信息；南方不容忽视

source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You did, however, poll a bit higher above what you were set to win. So good job outdoing your predictions. The south isn't done yet, as you've shown here.
zh: 正如大多数人所料，你输了。这并不奇怪，因为您是第三方。更糟糕的是，你使选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标失败了。然而，你的民意调查确实比你设定的获胜要高一些。干得好，超出了你的预测。正如您在此处所示，南部尚未完成。

source: As most expected, you've lost. This isn't a surprise, as you're a third party. even worse, your second goal of deadlocking the electoral college failed. You won just about as much as expected, and yet it wasn't enough. Your supporters are disillusioned that you weren't able to deadlock the college. That's how it is, though...
zh: 正如大多数人所料，你输了。这并不奇怪，因为您是第三方。更糟糕的是，你使选举人团陷入僵局的第二个目标失败了。你赢得了与预期一样多的胜利，但这还不够。你的支持者对你未能让学院陷入僵局感到失望。事情就是这样，不过……

source: What will be the overall theme of your campaign as you criss-cross the United States?
zh: 当您穿越美国时，您的竞选活动的总体主题是什么？

source: What will be the thrust of your speech as you accept the Republican nomination in Miami?
zh: 当您在迈阿密接受共和党提名时，您演讲的主旨是什么？

source: What is more important for your campaign -- competing with Humphrey in the swing states, or winning over Wallace voters in the south?
zh: 对于您的竞选活动来说，哪一个更重要——与摇摆州的汉弗莱竞争，还是赢得南部的华莱士选民？

source: Are you satisfied with the progress of desegregation in this country since the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964?
zh: 自 1964 年民权法案通过以来，您对这个国家废除种族隔离的进展感到满意吗？

source: Are you satisfied with this nation's economic performance over the previous five years?
zh: 您对这个国家过去五年的经济表现满意吗？

source: What is your opinion of Lyndon Johnson's new Medicare program?
zh: 您对林登·约翰逊的新联邦医疗保险计划有何看法？

source: Would you be willing to call an unconditional bombing halt of North Vietnam in the hopes of restarting peace negotiations?
zh: 您是否愿意无条件停止对北越的轰炸，以期重启和平谈判？

source: Do you support the Child Nutrition Act of 1966, which provides free breakfast and milk to qualified schoolchildren of impoverished backgrounds? Or do you believe that the program is too costly and constitutes a misuse of federal power?
zh: 您是否支持 1966 年《儿童营养法案》，该法案向贫困背景的合格学童提供免费早餐和牛奶？或者您是否认为该计划成本太高并且构成滥用联邦权力？

source: The unemployment rate is currently under 4%, in spite of the chaos that prevails in our nation. What will you do as president to keep unemployment low?
zh: 尽管我们国家普遍存在混乱，但失业率目前仍低于 4%。作为总统，你将采取什么措施来保持低失业率？

source: How would you prevent campus incidents like the takeover of Columbia University that occurred this past spring?
zh: 您将如何防止校园事件，例如去年春天发生的哥伦比亚大学被接管？

source: What do you think about the efforts of the AFL-CIO and other large unions? Do they have a positive effect on America?
zh: 您如何看待 AFL-CIO 和其他大型工会的努力？它们对美国有积极影响吗？

source: An alarming percentage of voters are inspired by the aggressively racist rhetoric of George Wallace. What will you do to win this group?
zh: 令人震惊的比例的选民受到乔治·华莱士的激进种族主义言论的鼓舞。为了赢得这个小组你会做什么？

source: How far are you willing to go to compete in the American South against the campaign of George Wallace?
zh: 您愿意在美国南部对抗乔治·华莱士的竞选活动走多远？

source: What is your opinion of the Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965? Is it a good idea to liberalize our immigration policy and to outlaw national origin quotas?
zh: 您对 1965 年《移民和国籍法》有何看法？放宽我们的移民政策并取缔国籍配额是个好主意吗？

source: As Governor of California, Ronald Reagan will be crucial to your chances in that state. Can you reassure him that you are sufficiently conservative to warrant his enthusiasm after your battle for the Republican nomination?
zh: 作为加利福尼亚州的州长，罗纳德·里根对于您在该州的机会至关重要。你能否向他保证，在你争夺共和党提名后，你足够保守，足以保证他的热情？

source: Can we all agree that the Black Panthers are a menace to the security of the United States?
zh: 我们都同意黑豹党对美国安全构成威胁吗？

source: Do you think the Department of Housing and Urban Development, newly created by Lyndon Johnson, serves a useful purpose in American life?
zh: 您认为林登·约翰逊新创建的住房和城市发展部对美国人的生活有什么用处吗？

source: Would you consider sending troops into Laos, Cambodia, or North Vietnam to more aggressively combat the flow of Communist troops into South Vietnam?
zh: 您是否会考虑向老挝、柬埔寨或北越派遣军队，以更积极地打击共产党军队流入南越？

source: Do you believe that President Johnson overstepped his bounds in negotiating the Kennedy Round of trade agreements? Do you support the liberalization of international trade under the GATT?
zh: 您是否认为总统约翰逊在谈判肯尼迪回合贸易协定时超越了界限？您支持关贸总协定下的国际贸易自由化吗？

source: What is causing the massive increase of crime in America? How will you reverse the trend?
zh: 是什么导致美国犯罪率大幅增加？您将如何扭转这一趋势？

source: What is your stance on the Six-Day War that occurred last year, and how should Israel handle the new territories it has taken possession of?
zh: 您对去年发生的六日战争持什么立场？以色列应如何处理其占领的新领土？

source: Are you concerned with some of the activist stances that Earl Warren has taken in his time with the Supreme Court?
zh: 您是否对厄尔·沃伦在最高法院任职期间采取的一些激进立场感到担忧？

source: Do we need more spending in the War on Poverty, especially in light of the riots since 1965?
zh: 我们是否需要在向贫困宣战中增加支出，特别是考虑到 1965 年以来的骚乱？

source: Sources have indicated that Johnson is close to reaching a breakthrough in negotiations with the North Vietnamese, which could almost assure a Democratic win on Tuesday. An operative with connections to the South Vietnam government is willing to sabotage these negotiations with promises that you will offer a better deal when elected. Will you take a chance on this plan?
zh: 消息人士表示，约翰逊与北越的谈判即将取得突破，这几乎可以确保民主党在周二获胜。一名与南越政府有联系的特工愿意破坏这些谈判，并承诺你当选后将提供更好的协议。你会尝试这个计划吗？

source: Absolutely not. I'm looking for ways to end this war with an honorable peace agreement, not ways to incite the wrath of Red China.
zh: 绝对不是。我正在寻找以光荣的和平协议结束这场战争的方法，而不是煽动红色中国的愤怒的方法。

source: We need to pull our forces out of Vietnam as soon as possible. This war is a national disgrace.
zh: 我们需要尽快从越南撤军。这场战争是民族耻辱。

source: Medicare is the first step towards socialized medicine in this country. We need to end this program as soon as possible and return health care to the states and to the people.
zh: 联邦医疗保险是这个国家迈向社会化医疗的第一步。我们需要尽快结束这个计划，将医疗保健还给各州和人民。

source: We need to be very cautious about this program. It's important to ensure that the indigent can receive care, but programs like these always run the risk of adding precipitously to our national deficit.
zh: 我们需要对此计划非常谨慎。确保贫困人口能够得到护理很重要，但此类计划总是面临着急剧增加国家赤字的风险。

source: I commend this piece of legislation. Already we see many Americans receiving health care who would otherwise be stricken with serious and/or fatal conditions.
zh: 我赞扬这项立法。我们已经看到许多美国人正在接受医疗保健，否则他们可能会患上严重和/或致命的疾病。

source: Medicare is only the beginning of what we need to do in this country. I support a national health care system for all Americans.
zh: 联邦医疗保险只是我们在这个国家需要做的事情的开始。我支持为所有美国人建立国家医疗保健系统。

source: How can anyone be satisfied with the course our nation has taken? Inflation is killing the value of the dollar and the gold standard itself is at risk. Unemployment is highest under the Johnson Administration among the very people he claims to care about the most.
zh: 怎么会有人对我们国家所采取的做法感到满意？通货膨胀正在削弱美元的价值，金本位制本身也面临风险。在约翰逊政府领导下，他声称最关心的人中失业率最高。

source: Our current economic path is not sustainable. We need to continue the growth we have seen but we cannot allow this inflation we have to continue.
zh: 我们当前的经济道路是不可持续的。我们需要继续我们已经看到的增长，但我们不能允许这种通货膨胀继续下去。

source: The unemployment rate right now is under four percent. Workers, particularly those in labor unions, enjoy high purchasing power and an ever-expanding lifestyle. Economic growth throughout the 1960s has been outstanding.
zh: 目前失业率低于百分之四。工人，特别是工会工人，享有较高的购买力和不断扩大的生活方式。整个 20 世纪 60 年代的经济增长非常出色。

source: The worst thing we can do right now is to sabotage the progress we have seen by continuing to squander our money on a war in Vietnam. I support a full employment economy as well -- meaning we must be vigilant against misguided attempts to raise interest rates.
zh: 我们现在能做的最糟糕的事情就是继续在越南战争上浪费我们的钱来破坏我们所取得的进展。我也支持充分就业经济——这意味着我们必须警惕错误的加息尝试。

source: Whites and Negroes are naturally unsuited to mix together in society. The entire premise of desegregation is a farce, and my campaign is dedicated to ending this misguided policy.
zh: 白人和黑人天生不适合在社会上混在一起。废除种族隔离的整个前提是一场闹剧，我的竞选活动致力于结束这一误导性的政策。

source: I strongly support what we have done to end the insidious practice of segregation in the South. However I'm also alarmed at some of the ideas I've heard about forced integration of neighborhoods, or the proposed busing of students to distant schools.
zh: 我强烈支持我们为结束南方阴险的种族隔离做法所做的一切。然而，我也对我听到的一些关于强制社区融合或提议将学生送往遥远学校的想法感到震惊。

source: We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that I shepherd the Civil Rights Act of 1957 through the Senate and have supported Civil Rights bills during my time in the House and Senate. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.
zh: 过去 20 年来，我们在这个问题上取得了巨大进步，让记录表明，我在参议院领导了 1957 年的民权法案法案，并在众议院和参议院任职期间支持了民权法案。然而，要真正实现马丁·路德·金的梦想，我们还有很长的路要走。

source: We need to be very aggressive in fighting racism and its effects where they exist. I support programs such as busing, affirmative action, the new HUD department, and anything else that is necessary to integrate all regions of the United States.
zh: 我们需要非常积极地打击种族主义及其存在的影响。我支持公交车、平权行动、新的 HUD 部门以及任何其他整合美国所有地区所需的项目。

source: If anything, we need to escalate the bombing of North Vietnam. I don't go to bed at night with the feeling that they truly respect the power of America.
zh: 如果有的话，我们需要升级对北越的轰炸。我晚上睡觉时不会感觉到他们真正尊重美国的力量。

source: We will never win the peace in Vietnam by caving in to the Communists. I cannot support such an ill-conceived measure.
zh: 我们永远不会通过屈服于共产党来赢得越南的和平。我不能支持这种考虑不周的措施。

source: I would be willing to take this step and see what develops. It is imperative that we end the war in Vietnam as soon as possible.
zh: 我愿意迈出这一步，看看会发生什么。当务之急是尽快结束越南战争。

source: I can't believe we haven't done this yet. How on earth are we supposed to win a war against an insidious enemy with one hand tied behind our back?
zh: 我不敢相信我们还没有做到这一点。我们到底如何能够单手绑在背后赢得一场针对阴险敌人的战争呢？

source: I don't think that kind of escalation is wise. The last thing we need is a regional war. I would stick to our mission of defending South Vietnam and preventing the spread of Communism.
zh: 我认为这种升级是不明智的。我们最不需要的就是地区战争。我将坚持保卫南越和防止共产主义蔓延的使命。

source: We should always be wary of the corruption inherent in these large unions. I cannot say that I'm a supporter of the AFL-CIO.
zh: 我们应该始终警惕这些大型工会固有的腐败现象。我不能说我是美国劳工联合会-产联的支持者。

source: Every man should have a choice on whether to join a union or not. These large outfits monopolize the work force and use their power to perpetrate voter fraud and to enrich their bosses.
zh: 每个男人都应该选择是否加入工会。这些大型机构垄断了劳动力，并利用其权力进行选民欺诈并为老板谋取利益。

source: The AFL-CIO is a centerpiece of the great American bargain. Our economy can never thrive unless the people who work to keep it going thrive as well. I fully support the AFL-CIO.
zh: AFL-CIO 是美国伟大讨价还价的核心。除非那些为经济发展而努力的人们也能蓬勃发展，否则我们的经济永远无法繁荣。我完全支持美国劳工联合会-产联。

source: Israel has every right to these territories they now occupy. They were attacked from all sides by an enemy bent on their destruction.
zh: 以色列对其现在占领的这些领土拥有一切权利。他们遭到一心要毁灭他们的敌人从四面八方的攻击。

source: As President, I'm confident that all sides can come together and negotiate a long-term peace agreement. Certainly the return of the Sinai or the Golan Heights should not be off the table.
zh: 作为总统，我相信各方能够齐心协力，谈判达成一项长期和平协议。当然，归还西奈半岛或戈兰高地不应被排除在外。

source: I fully support Israel's right to defend herself. However, I believe that these territories should be returned to the Arab states as a first step towards peace negotiations.
zh: 我完全支持以色列自卫的权利。然而，我认为这些领土应该归还给阿拉伯国家，作为和平谈判的第一步。

source: This business in Israel is no business of America. I wish them the best, but we should not be obtrusively inserting ourselves into these multilateral peace negotiations. Doing so will only serve to entangle us in the long run.
zh: 以色列的这项业务不属于美国。我祝愿他们一切顺利，但我们不应该强行介入这些多边和平谈判。这样做从长远来看只会让我们陷入困境。

source: Earl Warren is without a doubt the worst Supreme Court justice in the history of the United States. From Brown v. Board of Education up through the present day, he has been nothing but an agent of tyranny for the federal government.
zh: 厄尔·沃伦毫无疑问是美国历史上最糟糕的最高法院法官。来自 布朗诉教育委员会案 迄今为止，他只不过是联邦政府的暴政代理人。

source: On the balance I would not appoint another justice like Mr. Warren. Desegregating our schools was one thing, but he has gone off the deep end on these issues like school prayer, Miranda rights, and other activist decisions.
zh: 总的来说，我不会任命另一位像沃伦先生这样的法官。废除我们学校的种族隔离是一回事，但他在学校祈祷、米兰达权利和其他激进决定等问题上走得太极端了。

source: It would be better in some cases if we could get Congress to make these decisions, but I do support the stances Mr. Warren has taken on the Court.
zh: 在某些情况下，如果我们能让国会做出这些决定会更好，但我确实支持沃伦先生对法院采取的立场。

source: The Warren Court is the first Supreme Court in history which has had the guts to use constitutional law for the benefit of the common citizen. I will continue to appoint sound judges like Mr. Warren, Abe Fortas, and Thurgood Marshall.
zh: 沃伦法院是历史上第一个有勇气运用宪法造福普通公民的最高法院。我将继续任命像沃伦、Abe Fortas 和 Thurgood 马歇尔先生这样的优秀法官。

source: Can we just clarify my position on all of these fancy programs Johnson created? I oppose all of them. That includes HUD which will infringe on the rights of property owners and increase crime in our working class neighborhoods.
zh: 我们可以澄清我对创建的所有这些花哨程序约翰逊的立场吗？我全部反对。这包括住房和城市发展部（HUD），它将侵犯业主的权利并增加我们工人阶级社区的犯罪率。

source: I will do my best to ensure that this program is managed soundly and does not become some kind of welfare program without accountability.
zh: 我会尽力确保这个计划得到妥善管理，不会成为某种没有责任的福利计划。

source: We need to do everything in our power to ensure that our poorest citizens have affordable housing. The HUD department is a centerpiece of this initiative.
zh: 我们需要尽一切努力确保我们最贫困的公民拥有负担得起的住房。 HUD 部门是该计划的核心。

source: The Negro problem apparently wasn't enough for our federal bureaucrats, because they decided to add Mexicans and Orientals to the list as well. I oppose new immigration to this country.
zh: 黑人问题显然对我们的联邦官僚来说还不够，因为他们决定将墨西哥人和东方人也添加到名单中。我反对新移民进入这个国家。

source: We need to be vigilant on the amount of immigration that we allow, but I also agree that we shouldn't restrict the practice based on national origin. In a Cold War world, we need to be mindful of international perceptions.
zh: 我们需要对允许的移民数量保持警惕，但我也同意我们不应该根据国籍来限制这种做法。在冷战世界中，我们需要留意国际看法。

source: This is a fair and sensible policy that will allow skilled immigrants to enter the United States. It's ludicrous to state that this will somehow compromise our culture and our values.
zh: 这是一项公平且明智的政策，将允许技术移民进入美国。说这会在某种程度上损害我们的文化和价值观，这是荒谬的。

source: Our former immigration policy was a national embarrassment. This country was built by immigrants and my only complaint right now is that the overall number of visas is still far too low for our needs.
zh: 我们以前的移民政策是全国性的耻辱。这个国家是由移民建立的，我现在唯一的抱怨是签证总数仍然太少，无法满足我们的需求。

source: This increase in crime we see is the natural consequence of integration. I will not allow the black community in this country to get fancified notions of what they can get away with when I'm President.
zh: 我们看到的犯罪增加是一体化的自然结果。我不会允许这个国家的黑人社区对我担任总统时可以做的事情抱有幻想。

source: We have a system in place that gives precedence to the rights of criminals over law-abiding citizens. I will take a firm stand on this issue as President.
zh: 我们有一个制度，使罪犯的权利优先于守法公民。作为总统，我将在这个问题上采取坚定的立场。

source: We need to improve our policing practices, prevent riots and disorder, and also address the underlying economic causes that spread dissatisfaction with the status quo.
zh: 我们需要改进我们的警务实践，防止骚乱和骚乱，并解决传播对现状不满的根本经济原因。

source: There is a cynicism in our poorest neighborhoods engendered by poverty and by the brutality of the police. I will vigorously address both of these issues when I'm elected.
zh: 在我们最贫困的社区中，由于贫困和警察的暴行而产生了一种愤世嫉俗的情绪。当我当选后，我将积极解决这两个问题。

source: I don't think anyone opposes the idea of providing milk to our poor kids. My contention, however, is that the state and local governments are more in tune with their needs than some bureaucrats in Washington.
zh: 我想，没人反对给贫困儿童提供牛奶。但我的观点是，相较于华盛顿的一些官僚，州和地方政府更了解这些孩子的需要。

source: This is a sensible piece of legislation. I support it and I think that every decent American supports it too.
zh: 这是一项明智的立法。我支持它，我认为每一个正派的美国人也都支持它。

source: The Black Panthers are a radical group of militants who are plotting the overthrow of the United States government. It is my firm position, in accordance with the Constitution, that anyone planning treason against our country should be imprisoned and possibly executed.
zh: 黑豹党是一个激进的武装分子组织，他们正在密谋推翻美国政府。我的坚定立场是，根据宪法，任何计划叛国的人都应该被监禁，甚至可能被处决。

source: I support a fair shake for every American. I support programs that help black businesses. I support desegregation. I oppose groups like the Black Panthers that have contributed to the rioting and chaos that has swept the nation these past three years.
zh: 我支持为每个美国人提供公平的待遇。我支持帮助黑人企业的计划。我支持废除种族隔离。我反对像黑豹党这样的团体，他们在过去三年里助长了席卷全国的骚乱和混乱。

source: Our goal is a society that works for everyone. The Black Panthers have instigated some ugly incidents, and I believe on the balance that they have done more harm than good for the cause of integration.
zh: 我们的目标是建立一个为所有人服务的社会。黑豹党煽动了一些丑恶事件，我认为总的来说，他们对融合事业弊大于利。

source: How these students have not been expelled is beyond me. If Administrators want to be complicit in the degradation of a private university, that is their own business. However, I won't spend a dime of federal money on a school that coddles radical agitators.
zh: 我不明白这些学生怎么没有被开除。如果管理者想成为私立大学堕落的同谋，那是他们自己的事。然而，我不会花一毛钱联邦资金在一所纵容激进煽动者的学校上。

source: I will crack down on dope-smoking, homosexuality, LSD binging, illegal protesting, and flag-burning. These practices are the tools of left-wingers and Communists who wish to undermine our society.
zh: 我将严厉打击吸毒、同性恋、迷幻药、非法抗议和焚烧国旗。这些做法是左翼分子和共产党人想要破坏我们社会的工具。

source: There are some legitimate complaints behind these abhorrent actions. I will work for peace in Vietnam and civil rights in the United States. In the meantime, I support the rights of university administrators as they combat this problem.
zh: 这些令人憎恶的行为背后有一些合理的投诉。我将为越南和美国的民权和平而努力。与此同时，我支持大学管理人员解决这个问题的权利。

source: The unemployment rate won't stay low for long if we continue to pass new regulations on housing, mining, and industrial concerns. I speak for the working man when I say that we need to get the federal government out of these areas.
zh: 如果我们继续通过有关住房、采矿和工业问题的新法规，失业率不会长期保持在低位。当我说我们需要让联邦政府撤出这些地区时，我代表工人。

source: We are keeping the unemployment rate artificially depressed with unsound fiscal and monetary policies. In the long-run, this will lead to a poor economy and higher unemployment.
zh: 我们通过不健全的财政和货币政策人为压低失业率。从长远来看，这将导致经济低迷和失业率上升。

source: Democratic management of the economy these past eight years has been a clear success. I will continue to protect our unions and support the economy with smart government action.
zh: 过去八年对经济的民主管理取得了明显的成功。我将继续通过明智的政府行动保护我们的工会并支持经济。

source: There is far more we can do. Jobs training programs and a continued fight against discrimination will ensure that all Americans can share in the low unemployment rate.
zh: 我们能做的还有很多。就业培训计划和持续打击歧视将确保所有美国人都能分享低失业率的成果。

source: International trade will undermine the prosperity of the working man as quickly as it will undermine the sovereignty of the United States. I don't support any of these global organizations.
zh: 国际贸易将损害工人的繁荣，就像它损害美国的主权一样快。我不支持任何这些全球组织。

source: I support the overall thrust of this policy. Foreign trade supports our Cold War allies, reduces the cost of goods in America, and supports a broader economic prosperity.
zh: 我支持这项政策的总体主旨。对外贸易支持我们的冷战盟友，降低美国的商品成本，并支持更广泛的经济繁荣。

source: I support these international trade negotiations, but we must be sure that we don't undermine the rights of our own unions with one-sided agreements.
zh: 我支持这些国际贸易谈判，但我们必须确保我们不会通过片面协议损害我们自己工会的权利。

source: The War on Poverty is a national disgrace. It is a program that steals from the productive to finance the lazy and the shiftless.
zh: 向贫困宣战是国家耻辱。这是一个从生产力中窃取资金来资助懒惰和无能者的计划。

source: We need to focus less on handouts and more on encouraging initiative among our black and ethnic business owners. They will build the prosperity in our inner cities. I will analyze the War on Poverty on a program-by-program basis and cut those which are unnecessary.
zh: 我们需要减少对施舍的关注，而更多地关注鼓励黑人和少数族裔企业主的主动性。他们将建设我们内城的繁荣。我将逐个程序地分析向贫困宣战，并删除那些不需要的。

source: I support the War on Poverty as it stands. We have passed a lot of new initiatives and we should wait to see what effect they have. To me, cracking down on the law and order issues is more important.
zh: 我支持向贫困宣战的现状。我们已经通过了很多新举措，我们应该拭目以待，看看它们会产生什么效果。对我来说，打击法律与秩序问题更为重要。

source: We are the greatest nation on earth and we cannot rest until every citizen has an opportunity to share in that prosperity.
zh: 我们是地球上最伟大的国家，除非每个公民都有机会分享这种繁荣，否则我们不能休息。

source: I am the true conservative in this election. I support free enterprise, a hard line against Communism, and a devolution of responsibilities to the state governments.
zh: 这次选举我是真正的保守派。我支持自由企业、反对共产主义的强硬路线以及将责任下放给州政府。

source: My primary focus is to return law and order to this country. The riots, the murders, the drug use, and the protests we've seen since 1965 are unacceptable.
zh: 我的首要任务是让法律与秩序返回这个国家。自 1965 年以来我们所看到的骚乱、谋杀、吸毒和抗议都是不可接受的。

source: Lyndon Johnson has created more programs and agencies than any President except for FDR. I will act more in line with the wishes of the American people.
zh: 林登·约翰逊创建的计划和机构比除富兰克林·罗斯福之外的任何总统都多。我会更加符合美国人民的意愿。

source: I am not a radical like Goldwater. I am a pragmatic, moderate problem-solver who will tackle the challenges of inflation and disorder with even-handedness.
zh: 我不像戈德华特那样激进。我是一个务实、温和的问题解决者，将不偏不倚地应对通货膨胀和混乱的挑战。

source: The Vietnam War and the disorder in this country shows that our leadership has failed. I will work for American enterprise, end the war with honor, and end the violence in the streets.
zh: 越南战争和这个国家的混乱表明我们的领导失败了。我将为美国企业工作，光荣地结束战争，结束街头暴力。

source: The actions of Lyndon Johnson since 1964 are exactly what Goldwater warned us about. The American people are ready to reconsider the message of true conservatism.
zh: 自 1964 年以来林登·约翰逊的行为正是戈德华特警告我们的。美国人民准备重新考虑真正保守主义的信息。

source: I will praise Johnson's social programs like Medicare, while also lamenting the disorder in the streets. I will pledge to work with Democrats to find common ground at home and to end the war in Vietnam.
zh: 我会赞扬约翰逊像联邦医疗保险一样的社会项目，同时也会感叹街道上的混乱。我将承诺与民主党合作，在国内找到共同点并结束越南战争。

source: I will focus most of my speech on the need to win in Vietnam. I will promise the American people that with more aggressive action, we can end the war there and bring our troops home.
zh: 我演讲的大部分内容将重点放在在越南获胜的必要性上。我将向美国人民保证，通过采取更积极的行动，我们可以结束那里的战争，并将我们的军队带回家。

source: We want to compete in every southern state. I will run to the right of Wallace on economic issues while lamenting the interference of the federal government in education and housing.
zh: 我们要在南方每个州争取胜利。我将在经济问题上采取比华莱士更右的立场，同时批评联邦政府干预教育和住房事务。

source: We'll win some states and lose some states in the South. I will campaign elsewhere in the country and ignore racial issues as much as possible.
zh: 我们将赢得南方的一些州并失去一些州。我将在全国其他地方竞选，并尽可能忽视种族问题。

source: By staking the middle ground between Wallace and Humphrey on racial issues, I will split them apart and win a national majority.
zh: 通过在种族问题上在华莱士和汉弗莱之间采取中间立场，我将分裂他们并赢得全国多数。

source: I will make it a point to disavow racial divisiveness as I travel, lest there be any doubt of my stance. We can solidly defeat Humphrey outside of the South and win a mandate for real governance.
zh: 我将在旅行时强调否认种族分歧，以免我的立场受到任何怀疑。我们可以在南方之外坚定地击败汉弗莱，并赢得真正治理的授权。

source: Ronald Reagan and I do not agree on every issue. I trust that he will work for the team in 1968 if he wants a future in the Republican Party.
zh: 罗纳德·里根我并不在每个问题上都达成一致。我相信如果他想在共和党拥有未来，他会在 1968 年为球队工作。

source: Reagan and I have real common ground on the law and order issue. I will remind him of this when we discuss our politics.
zh: 里根和我在法律与秩序问题上有真正的共同点。当我们讨论我们的政治时，我会提醒他这一点。

source: The Republican Party will always stand for free enterprise and common-sense solutions. I am conservative just the same as Ronald Reagan is.
zh: 共和党将始终代表自由企业和常识性解决方案。我和罗纳德·里根一样保守。

source: We have involved Ronald Reagan extensively in our campaign. I think that is clear for anyone to see.
zh: 我们广泛参与了罗纳德·里根我们的活动。我想这对任何人来说都是显而易见的。

source: I refuse to condone this kind of a plan. I have limits on what I will do to win an election.
zh: 我拒绝宽恕这种计划。我对赢得选举所做的事情有限制。

source: This will guarantee victory for us if successful. Let's roll the dice.
zh: 如果成功的话，这将保证我们的胜利。让我们掷骰子吧。

source: We can't have the American people saying that I'm afraid to debate Hubert Humphrey. Let's do it.
zh: 我们不能让美国人民说我害怕与休伯特辩论汉弗莱。我们开始做吧。

source: I won't risk a debate with Humphrey. We can defeat him without one.
zh: 我不会冒险与汉弗莱辩论。我们无需任何人就可以击败他。

source: If we want to scoop up some states in the South, we can't say anything too agressive about racial issues. Let's just focus on Humphrey for now.
zh: 如果我们想抢占南方的一些州，我们就不能在种族问题上说太激进的话。现在我们只关注汉弗莱。

source: We need to remind voters that Wallace is still a Democrat, and that his goal is to throw the election to the House.
zh: 我们需要提醒选民，华莱士仍然是民主党人，他的目标是将选举交给众议院。

source: Doesn't this hurt Humphrey more than it does myself? Wallace's support amongst union voters in the North helps our campaign.
zh: 这对汉弗莱的伤害是不是比我自己还要大？华莱士北方工会选民的支持有助于我们的竞选活动。

source: In a prime-time national speech, I will directly address the candidacy of Mr. Wallace and appeal to the better nature of our union voters.
zh: 在黄金时段的全国演讲中，我将直接谈论华莱士先生的候选资格，并呼吁我们工会选民的善良本性。

source: I'm just going to run my campaign and whatever happens with those two will happen.
zh: 我只是要开展我的竞选活动，无论这两个人发生什么，都会发生。

source: We shall certianly be campaigning in the South to some extent. We can't just concede the entire region to Wallace.
zh: 我们肯定会在某种程度上在南方开展竞选活动。我们不能将整个地区让给华莱士。

source: Humphrey is our main opponent in key states, such as Ohio, Illinois, and California. We must focus on campaigning against him in these key states, or else, god forbid, Wallace actually deadlocks the Electoral College.
zh: 汉弗莱是我们在关键州的主要对手，例如俄亥俄州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州。我们必须集中精力在这些关键州开展针对他的竞选活动，否则，上帝保佑，华莱士实际上会使选举人团陷入僵局。

source: You do want to make appeals to the conservative base, but Medicare is a very popular program. Perhaps another issue would be better for this kind of thing.
zh: 你确实需要争取保守派基本盘，但联邦医疗保险是一项深受欢迎的政策。要讨好保守派，或许该换个议题。

source: The Republicans did not nominate you so that you could go on the trail and talk about socializing the health care system.
zh: 共和党提名您并不是为了让您能够继续讨论医疗保健系统的社会化。

source: It may be a hard sell, but you need to make the case that something is wrong with the economy. After all, the Democrats have controlled everything for eight years now.
zh: 这可能很难推销，但你需要证明这一点 一些东西 经济是错误的。毕竟，民主党已经控制一切八年了。

source: Economists agree that you have staked out a position on the liberal fringe of the economic debate.
zh: 经济学家一致认为，您在经济辩论的自由主义边缘表明了立场。

source: Your principles are admirable, but you're in danger of sounding like Goldwater in '64.
zh: 你的原则令人钦佩，但你有听起来像 64 年的戈德华特的危险。

source: This should hit the spot, given the riots and chaos this country has witnessed over the past three years.
zh: 考虑到这个国家在过去三年里经历的骚乱和混乱，这应该是切中要害的。

source: There are a lot of angles you can attack from, but for the most part people are happy with Johnson's programs. You'd do better targeting the Democrats on the war or the incessant rioting.
zh: 您可以从很多角度进行攻击，但大多数情况下人们对约翰逊的程序感到满意。你最好把矛头指向民主党，因为战争或持续不断的骚乱。

source: This stance may rankle some true believers, but it will definitely help you compete in the Midwest and Northeast.
zh: 这种立场可能会激怒一些真正的信徒，但它肯定会帮助你在中西部和东北部竞争。

source: Don't bring Goldwater's name into this. There are far better ways to attack the Democrats.
zh: 不要将戈德华特的名字带入其中。有更好的方法来攻击民主党。

source: A moderate stance like this will help you win a broad coalition of voters in the fall.
zh: 像这样的温和立场将帮助您在秋季赢得广泛的选民联盟。

source: Did you just promise to escalate the war in Vietnam? This might make you popular in certain quarters, but it won't help you win this fall.
zh: 你刚刚承诺要升级越南战争吗？这可能会让你在某些方面很受欢迎，但不会帮助你在今年秋天获胜。

source: You may be banging your head against a concrete wall trying to beat Wallace in states like Louisiana.
zh: 在路易斯安那州这样的州，你可能会用头撞混凝土墙，试图击败华莱士。

source: You'd better take some big states in the North in order for this answer to pay off.
zh: 为了让这个答案得到回报，你最好选择北方的一些大州。

source: Reagan may not be pleased with your perfunctory gestures, but he is also not that popular with the northern wing of the party. Everything is a trade off.
zh: 里根可能对你敷衍的姿态不满意，但他也不太受党内北翼的欢迎。一切都是权衡。

source: As word of a possible peace deal breaks, Humphrey is surging in the final polls. Will you have the votes you need on election day? Sit down and watch the results come in.
zh: 随着可能达成和平协议的消息传出，汉弗莱在最终民意调查中的排名飙升。您能在选举日获得所需的选票吗？坐下来看看结果出来。

source: The peace talks collapsed on the final weekend before the election. Unfortunately, the news has also broken that you had something to do with it! Settle in to watch the returns, and pray that you can somehow pull this out...
zh: 和谈在选举前的最后一个周末破裂。不幸的是，有消息称你与这件事有关！安顿下来观看选举结果，并祈祷你能以某种方式解决这个问题......

source: Your gamble has paid off. Humphrey's momentum was halted when the peace talks collapsed, and there hasn't been a word in the news to suggest you had a part in it. The only thing left to do now is to watch the returns come in.
zh: 你的冒险奏效了。和谈破裂遏制了汉弗莱的势头，新闻里也没有任何迹象表明你参与其中。现在，只需静候计票结果。

source: Unfortunately, Humphrey absolutely trounced you in the debate you agreed to have. Your gamble did not pay off.
zh: 不幸的是，汉弗莱在你同意的辩论中彻底击败了你。你的赌博没有得到回报。

source: Observers agreed that Humphrey seemed to be the better debater, but you avoided any serious mistakes. Overall the impact will be minor.
zh: 观察者一致认为汉弗莱似乎是更好的辩手，但你避免了任何严重的错误。总体来说影响会很小。

source: Wow! You held Humphrey to a draw and seemed in command of yourself throughout. What a turnaround from 1960.
zh: 哇！你将汉弗莱打成了平局，并且似乎自始至终都能掌控自己。与 1960 年相比，情况发生了多么大的转变。

source: Humphrey will spend the rest of the campaign needling you on this issue. Of course, you've started out with such a lead that it hopefully won't matter in the end.
zh: 汉弗莱将在竞选活动的剩余时间里就这个问题对你进行针锋相对。当然，一开始你就处于领先地位，希望最终不会有什么影响。

source: This is not what most Democrats want to hear you say when you talk about Medicare.
zh: 当您谈论联邦医疗保险时，这不是大多数民主党人想听到的。

source: You are being cheered along by the liberal wing of the party, but overall you've probably lost votes with this position.
zh: 你受到了党内自由派的欢呼，但总的来说，你可能因这个立场而失去了选票。

source: Managing the economy is one thing that the Democrats have done right. You should own this issue -- not be running from it.
zh: 管理经济是民主党做得对的一件事。你应该承认这个问题——而不是逃避它。

source: This is the exact opposite of what you need to be saying.
zh: 这与您需要说的完全相反。

source: What is more important for your campaign -- competing with Humphrey in the swing states, or winning over Wallace voters in the south?
zh: 对于您的竞选活动来说，哪一个更重要——与摇摆州的汉弗莱竞争，还是赢得南部的华莱士选民？

source: What do you think of programs that require schools to use busing to achieve racial balance?
zh: 您如何看待要求学校使用校车来实现种族平衡的计划？

source: What is the maximum number of troops that you would commit to Vietnam?
zh: 您最多可以向越南派遣多少部队？

source: Some have proposed implementing an Environmental Protection Agency at the federal level to combat industrial pollution. Would you support this as President?
zh: 一些人提议在联邦一级设立环境保护局来应对工业污染。作为总统，您会支持这一做法吗？

source: Did the Supreme Court overstep its bounds in Loving v. Virginia by declaring state miscegenation statutes unconstitutional?
zh: 最高法院是否越界？ 爱诉弗吉尼亚州 宣布州通婚法规违宪？

source: Would you consider a constitutional amendment to outlaw the birth control pill, given the Supreme Court's decisions on that issue?
zh: 鉴于最高法院对此问题的裁决，您是否会考虑修改宪法以取缔避孕药？

source: Would you be willing to place increasing responsibility in the hands of South Vietnam for their own defense?
zh: 您愿意让南越承担越来越多的防御责任吗？

source: Do you support opening a new dialogue with our Communist adversaries, such as the Soviet Union and China?
zh: 您是否支持与我们的共产主义对手（例如苏联和中国）开展新的对话？

source: Will you try to compete with Johnson and Humphrey's political machine in Texas?
zh: 你会尝试在得克萨斯州中与约翰逊和汉弗莱的政治机器竞争吗？

source: Did you support Lyndon Johnson's 1965 intervention in the Dominican Republic?
zh: 您支持林登·约翰逊 1965 年对多米尼加共和国的干预吗？

source: What do you think of the late Dr. Martin Luther King?
zh: 您如何看待已故博士马丁·路德·金？

source: Do you hope to achieve an arms control agreement with the Soviet Union during your time in the Oval Office? What conditions would you agree to?
zh: 您在椭圆形办公室任职期间是否希望与苏联达成军控协议？什么条件你会同意？

source: We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that Hubert H. Humphrey was at the forefront of this movement as early as 1948. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.
zh: 过去二十年来，我们在这个问题上取得了巨大的进步——让记录表明，休伯特·H.·汉弗莱早在1948年就走在了这场运动的最前沿。然而，在我们真正实现马丁·路德·金的梦想之前，我们还有很长的路要走。

source: This is one of the most dangerous ideas I can think of. A federal agency to combat pollution will hurt business, increase unemployment, and undermine the wages of our workers.
zh: 这是我能想到的最危险的想法之一。打击污染的联邦机构将损害企业、增加失业率并降低我们工人的工资。

source: I believe that existing government agencies can handle the issues we have. It does upset any decent American to see rivers filled with black sludge and industrial waste.
zh: 我相信现有的政府机构可以处理我们遇到的问题。看到河流充满黑色污泥和工业废物，任何正派的美国人都会感到不安。

source: This is something I whole-heartedly support. We have rivers that are unusable to humans, acid rain falling from the skies, and smog so thick in some cities that people can barely see.
zh: 这是我全心全意支持的事情。我们有人类无法使用的河流，从天而降的酸雨，以及一些城市浓重的雾霾，人们几乎看不见。

source: Only if they proved themselves capable of repelling Communist aggression. The best thing we can do right now is escalate the war with more American troops.
zh: 只有他们证明自己有能力击退共产党的侵略。我们现在能做的最好的事情就是派遣更多的美国军队来升级战争。

source: This should be the primary goal of our policy in Vietnam. It's tragic how many American boys have died to defend a country that is not ready to defend itself.
zh: 这应该是我们越南政策的首要目标。可悲的是，有多少美国男孩为了保卫一个尚未准备好保卫自己的国家而牺牲。

source: My goal is President will be to negotiate a comprehensive peace treaty between North and South Vietnam and end this war. That is the only real solution.
zh: 我的目标是总统将在北越和南越之间谈判一项全面和平条约并结束这场战争。这是唯一真正的解决方案。

source: I will withdraw American troops from Vietnam as soon as possible. The South Vietnamese should be capable of defending their own borders if they are as afraid of the Communist menace as they say they are.
zh: 我将尽快从越南撤军。如果南越人像他们所说的那样害怕共产党的威胁，他们应该有能力保卫自己的边界。

source: I will provide as many troops as our generals say they need. One of the reasons we are losing this war right now is because we are not fully committed to it.
zh: 我将提供我们的将军们所需要的尽可能多的部队。我们现在输掉这场战争的原因之一是我们没有完全致力于它。

source: I believe that the troop strength we have now is sufficient to hold the lines until we obtain a peace agreement.
zh: 我相信我们现在拥有的兵力足以坚守防线，直到我们达成和平协议。

source: We need to reduce our troop strength to the minimum necessary level to prevent the downfall of South Vietnam while we work these issues out at the bargaining table.
zh: 当我们在谈判桌上解决这些问题时，我们需要将我们的兵力减少到必要的最低水平，以防止南越垮台。

source: Is this question some kind of a joke? We need to withdraw all American troops from Vietnam.
zh: 这个问题是开玩笑吗？我们需要从越南撤出所有美军。

source: You know, if some miracle occurred and these Communist adversaries were finally ready to explore a new system and allow democracy within their borders, we would be the first to welcome them to the free world.
zh: 你知道，如果出现奇迹，这些共产主义对手最终准备好探索新制度并在其境内实现民主，我们将是第一个欢迎他们来到自由世界的人。

source: We should always be looking for areas of agreement, however limited, between ourselves, the Soviet Union, and Red China. At the very least, we can implement arms treaties and avoid the threat of a nuclear war.
zh: 我们应该始终寻找我们、苏联和红色中国之间的一致意见，无论多么有限。至少，我们可以执行军备条约，避免核战争的威胁。

source: The best way to prevent future Communist aggression is not through the death of 25,000 American kids in Vietnam. I support a comprehensive summit aimed at codifying peace in the modern world.
zh: 防止未来共产主义侵略的最佳方法不是让 25,000 名美国儿童在越南死亡。我支持召开旨在将现代世界的和平编入法典的全面峰会。

source: I support a new era in U.S. - Communist relations. We have to be realistic and accept that Communism is here to stay, and work within that framework to find reasonable compromise in foreign affairs.
zh: 我支持美共关系的新时代。我们必须现实一点，承认共产主义将继续存在，并在这个框架内努力在外交事务上找到合理的妥协。

source: My God, someone has to step in and protect good order in this society. This is just another instance of federal judges taking control over an issue that's simply none of their business.
zh: 天哪，必须有人介入并维护这个社会的良好秩序。这只是联邦法官控制一个与他们无关的问题的又一个例子。

source: I'm not going to comment on a decision like this one. I certainly don't support miscegenation laws by any means, but I also think the Court has to be careful about overstepping the rights of the states.
zh: 我不会对这样的决定发表评论。我当然不以任何方式支持通婚法，但我也认为法院必须小心不要侵犯各州的权利。

source: I fully support the Supreme Court in this decision. I don't know how someone in 1968 can stand up and fight against two peoples' right to marry each other.
zh: 我完全支持最高法院的这一决定。我不知道1968年的人怎么能站出来反对两国人民结婚的权利。

source: Busing is nothing but another conspiracy to mongrelize the races of this country. First it was the Brown decision. Now it's some policy that some academic came up with to send children to school thirty miles from their house as part of some social engineering scheme.
zh: 巴士只不过是另一个使这个国家的种族混杂的阴谋。首先是布朗的决定。现在，一些学者提出了一些政策，将孩子们送到离家三十英里的地方上学，作为社会工程计划的一部分。

source: I stand opposed to the legal segregation of our schools. Legal segregation promotes inferior education. I also think that busing promotes inferior education. My goal is to see every child in this country get a good education.
zh: 我反对我们学校的合法隔离。合法的隔离促进了低劣的教育。我还认为乘公交车促进了低劣的教育。我的目标是看到这个国家的每个孩子都受到良好的教育。

source: I do agree with the idea that education is a local matter. I'm not especially opposed to busing where local authorities deem it necessary, but I would only use the federal government in extraordinary circumstances.
zh: 我确实同意教育是地方事务的观点。我并不是特别反对地方当局认为有必要的地方乘坐公交车，但我只会在特殊情况下使用联邦政府。

source: What good is a Court decision banning segregation if we don't actually do something to integrate our schools? People oppose busing because they oppose school integration, pure and simple.
zh: 如果我们不实际采取措施使我们的学校融合，那么法院禁止种族隔离的决定有什么好处呢？人们反对校车纯粹是因为他们反对学校整合。

source: I wish we would have had the guts to intervene in Cuba the way we did in the Dominican Republic. I will do anything I can as President to prevent a Communist insurgency in Latin America.
zh: 我希望我们有勇气像干预多米尼加共和国那样干预古巴。作为总统，我将尽我所能阻止拉丁美洲的共产主义叛乱。

source: With minimal cost and minimal loss of life, President Johnson was able to prevent a Communist uprising in the Dominican Republic. I fully support his actions in that area.
zh: 总统约翰逊以最小的成本和最小的生命损失阻止了多米尼加共和国的共产主义起义。我完全支持他在该领域的行动。

source: I do support the intervention. We also need to reexamine our policies in general towards Latin America to ensure higher economic growth and more political freedom there.
zh: 我确实支持干预。我们还需要重新审视我们对拉丁美洲的总体政策，以确保那里更高的经济增长和更多的政治自由。

source: We have long supported right-wing government in the Dominican Republic, and we've now propped it up against the will of the people. We can't credibly claim to fight for democracy when we do things like this.
zh: 我们长期以来一直支持多米尼加共和国的右翼政府，但现在我们却违背人民的意愿来支持它。当我们做这样的事情时，我们不能可信地声称为民主而战。

source: Dr. King bamboozled a lot of decent Americans with his rhetoric. I don't condone what happened to him, but most people fail to realize that he was a radical redistributionist and a borderline Communist.
zh: 金博士用他的言论迷惑了很多正派的美国人。我不会宽恕发生在他身上的事情，但大多数人没有意识到他是一个激进的再分配主义者和一个边缘共产主义者。

source: Dr. King is an American hero. I'm proud of his efforts to desegregate the southern schools and businesses, and I was deeply affected by his tragic demise this year.
zh: 金博士是美国英雄。我为他为废除南方学校和企业种族隔离所做的努力感到自豪，今年他的悲惨去世也让我深受影响。

source: We need to continue to fight for the legacy of Dr. King. The continuing poverty of the blacks in our cities and in the South is a sobering reminder of how much work is left to be done.
zh: 我们需要继续为金博士的遗产而奋斗。我们城市和南方黑人的持续贫困清醒地提醒我们还有多少工作要做。

source: An arms control agreement with the Soviet Union isn't worth the paper that it's signed on. I won't participate in that kind of a charade.
zh: 与苏联签署的军备控制协议不值一文。我不会参加那种猜谜游戏。

source: I would be open-minded about this issue. Without a clear statement of good faith, backed by concrete action, I have a hard time believing that the Soviet Union will come around to arms control.
zh: 我对这个问题持开放态度。如果没有明确的善意声明和具体行动的支持，我很难相信苏联会改变军备控制立场。

source: I will definitely work towards the control of nuclear weapons as President. I sincerely hope that we can work out a reasonable agreement on this issue.
zh: 作为总统，我一定会为控制核武器而努力。我真诚地希望我们能够就这个问题达成一个合理的协议。

source: My goal is a world without nuclear weapons. While being mindful of reality, I hope to negotiate an expansive agreement that can put an end to the arms race.
zh: 我的目标是一个没有核武器的世界。在考虑现实的同时，我希望通过谈判达成一项能够结束军备竞赛的广泛协议。

source: The Pill does not augur well for the social health of this nation. If we could get the support I'd love to see an Amendment that settles this issue once and for all.
zh: 避孕药对于这个国家的社会健康来说并不是一个好兆头。如果我们能得到支持，我希望看到一项修正案能够一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

source: We have bigger priorities to deal with right now in America. I don't think that most Americans support or expect this kind of an initiative.
zh: 我们现在在美国有更重要的优先事项要处理。我认为大多数美国人并不支持或期望这种举措。

source: My internal polling shows we have a real shot at Texas. Why wouldn't I campaign there?
zh: 我的内部民意调查显示我们确实有机会获得得克萨斯州。我为什么不去那里竞选呢？

source: We need to focus our efforts in the most efficient manner. I don't think spending a lot of time in Texas is really the thing to do for us.
zh: 我们需要以最有效的方式集中精力。我不认为在得克萨斯州上花费大量时间对我们来说确实是值得做的事情。

source: I'm more worried about keeping the rest of the South from going to Wallace. I'm less concerned about Humphrey's chances in Texas.
zh: 我更担心阻止南方其他人去华莱士。我不太关心汉弗莱在得克萨斯州中的机会。

source: With all of the new programs that have implemented over the past five years, do you still believe there is room for the federal government to expand its responsibilities?
zh: 过去五年来实施了所有新计划，您仍然认为联邦政府还有扩大其职责的空间吗？

source: Do you believe that the newly implemented federal welfare programs will be effective?
zh: 您认为新实施的联邦福利计划会有效吗？

source: What is your opinion on the legality of abortion? Would you attempt to legalize or prohibit this practice at the federal level?
zh: 您对堕胎的合法性有何看法？您会尝试在联邦层面合法化或禁止这种做法吗？

source: My God, this is a truly frightening question. Responsibilities of government need to be turned over to the states, and the federal government needs to be drastically reduced in size.
zh: 天哪，这真是一个可怕的问题。政府的职责需要移交给各州，联邦政府的规模需要大幅缩减。

source: The Great Society is founded upon the best of intentions, but we cannot afford this growth in spending on wasteful programs throughout our government.
zh: 伟大社会是建立在最好的意图之上的，但我们无法承受整个政府在浪费性项目上的支出增长。

source: I will do everything in my power to defend the Great Society initiatives that we have. In those cases where these programs fail to eradicate poverty, I will not hesitate to augment them.
zh: 我将竭尽全力捍卫我们现有的伟大社会举措。如果这些计划未能消除贫困，我会毫不犹豫地扩大这些计划。

source: We still need a national health care system. We still need a federal education system. Our work is never finished as long as poverty exists in the United States.
zh: 我们仍然需要国家医疗保健系统。我们仍然需要联邦教育体系。只要美国还存在贫困，我们的工作就永远不会完成。

source: Ineffective, immoral, and illegal. Intellectuals in improperly influential offices are destroying the United States.
zh: 无效、不道德且非法。担任不正当影响力办公室的知识分子正在摧毁美国。

source: I hope for all of our sakes that these programs work, but history proves that they may well have unintended consequences.
zh: 为了我们所有人的利益，我希望这些计划能够发挥作用，但历史证明它们很可能会产生意想不到的后果。

source: These will absolutely work. The condition of the indigent classes in this country is appalling.
zh: 这些绝对有效。这个国家的贫困阶层的状况令人震惊。

source: Abortion is an evil, murderous practice. I will stand firm against any attempts to protect this barbarism at the federal level.
zh: 堕胎是一种邪恶的、杀人的行为。我将坚决反对任何在联邦层面保护这种野蛮行径的企图。

source: We all have our own opinions on this practice, but I think the current system is the one that we should stay with. The individual states should be allowed to legislate on abortion as they so please.
zh: 我们对这种做法都有自己的看法，但我认为现行制度是我们应该坚持的制度。应该允许各个州按照自己的意愿就堕胎立法。

source: I'm opposed to the practice of abortion personally, but I would support a federal law protecting access to this procedure in the most dire cases for the woman, such as when her life or health are in danger.
zh: 我个人反对堕胎的做法，但我支持制定联邦法律，保护妇女在最危急的情况下使用堕胎程序，例如当她的生命或健康受到威胁时。

source: I support the right of women to control their reproductive destiny. This should be defended at the federal level.
zh: 我支持女性掌控自己生育命运的权利。这应该在联邦层面得到辩护。

source: I'm just going to run my campaign, and whatever happens with those two shall happen.
zh: 我只是要开展我的竞选活动，无论这两个人发生什么，都会发生。

source: Has the current Supreme Court contributed to our disorder with decisions such as Gideon v. Wainright and Miranda v. Arizona?
zh: 现任最高法院是否通过以下决定导致了我们的混乱？ 吉迪恩诉温赖特 和 米兰达诉亚利桑那州?

source: Should Lyndon Johnson have been able to prevent the Tet Offensive?
zh: 林登·约翰逊应该能够阻止春节攻势吗？

source: What is your position on expanding the Clean Air Act of 1963? Do you believe that stricter enforcement against pollutants is necessary, or does the current law suffice?
zh: 您对于扩大 1963 年清洁空气法案的立场是什么？您认为是否有必要对污染物采取更严格的执法力度，或者现行法律是否足够？

source: Have you given any thought to programs that would set racial quotas for job hiring or college admissions, in order to accelerate the process of integration?
zh: 您是否考虑过为工作招聘或大学招生设定种族配额的计划，以加速融合进程？

source: The Tet Offensive was an absolute disaster for the North Vietnamese. Why should it have been prevented?
zh: 春节攻势对于北越来说绝对是一场灾难。为什么应该阻止它？

source: I'm worried that for most or all of 1967, Lyndon Johnson repeatedly assured us that the North Vietnamese were on their last legs. It's difficult to assess the situation when we can't rely on the information that we have.
zh: 我担心在 1967 年的大部分时间里，林登·约翰逊不断向我们保证北越人已是奄奄一息。当我们不能依赖我们所掌握的信息时，就很难评估情况。

source: We should have had greater security in those places where we were attacked. Let us not forget, however, that this attack greatly hurt the Viet Cong and was a victory for the United States.
zh: 我们应该在那些受到攻击的地方加强安全保障。但我们不要忘记，这次袭击极大地伤害了越共，却是美国的胜利。

source: We could have prevented the Tet Offensive entirely if we'd never entangled ourselves in this Vietnamese quagmire.
zh: 如果我们不陷入越南泥潭，我们本可以完全阻止春节攻势。

source: Over the past five years we've sent a message to criminals that their rights are more important than the rights of law-abiding Americans. I don't know how anyone was surprised at the rioting and social chaos that we've seen since then.
zh: 在过去的五年里，我们向犯罪分子传达了这样一个信息：他们的权利比守法美国人的权利更重要。我不知道从那时起我们看到的骚乱和社会混乱有什么人感到惊讶。

source: My priority as President will be to fight for law and order in this country. The Court had good intentions but I am concerned that they overstepped their bounds in these cases.
zh: 作为总统，我的首要任务是在这个国家争取法律与秩序。法院的初衷是好的，但我担心他们在这些案件中越界了。

source: Due process for defendants is a Constitutional right. I'm confident that we will find a way to enforce the law in this country without devolving into a police state.
zh: 被告的正当程序是一项宪法权利。我相信我们会找到一种方法在这个国家执行法律而不致沦为警察国家。

source: You're dang right I've given some thought to this. We have laws in the books right now that require federal contractors to hire unqualified candidates, and we need to repeal them immediately.
zh: 你说得对，我已经考虑过这个问题了。我们现在有法律要求联邦承包商雇用不合格的候选人，我们需要立即废除它们。

source: We promise an equal opportunity to every person to succeed in America. I oppose discrimination in federal hiring and so on, but we also need to ask ourselves if a quota system is really the best way to monitor this issue.
zh: 我们承诺为每个人提供在美国取得成功的平等机会。我反对联邦招聘等方面的歧视，但我们也需要扪心自问，配额制度是否真的是监控这个问题的最佳方式。

source: We absolutely need laws prohibiting discrimination, and we need to go the extra mile in ensuring equal opportunity for women and minorities. Kennedy and Johnson's executive orders relating to federal hiring do just that.
zh: 我们绝对需要禁止歧视的法律，并且我们需要付出更多努力来确保妇女和少数族裔的平等机会。肯尼迪和约翰逊与联邦招聘相关的行政命令就是这样做的。

source: What we have now is a good start, but we need to be taking more affirmative action to fight against the effects of racial injustice in this country.
zh: 我们现在拥有一个良好的开端，但我们需要采取更多平权行动来对抗这个国家种族不公正的影响。

source: This is another case of pointy-headed intellectualism that will regulate our factories right out of business and kill the jobs of the working man.
zh: 这是又一个尖锐的唯智主义案例，它将导致我们的工厂停业并扼杀工人的工作。

source: We need to find a balance between protecting the environment and protecting our economy. I support this Act but we also need to enforce it in a practical manner.
zh: 我们需要在保护环境和保护经济之间找到平衡。我支持这项法案，但我们也需要以实际的方式执行它。

source: I dream of a country where every citizen has clean air to breathe. The Clean Air Act is a good start but I'm not opposed to further legislation in this area.
zh: 我梦想有一个每个公民都可以呼吸清洁空气的国家。 《清洁空气法案》是一个良好的开端，但我并不反对在这一领域进一步立法。

source: What will you say in your acceptance speech at the Democratic Convention in Chicago? Will you address the rioting outside and the legacy of Robert Kennedy?
zh: 您在芝加哥民主党代表大会上的获奖感言中会说什么？你会解决外面的骚乱和罗伯特·肯尼迪的遗留问题吗？

source: What is the overall theme of your campaign, remembering that the Democratic Party is underfunded and severely divided?
zh: 您活动的总体主题是什么，请记住民主党资金不足且严重分裂？

source: What is your overall position on the Vietnam War?
zh: 您对越南战争的总体立场是什么？

source: Richard Nixon, perhaps remembering the debacle of 1960, has expressed little interest in a debate this election. Will you challenge him to one?
zh: 理查德·尼克松也许还记得 1960 年的惨败，因此对这次选举的辩论没有什么兴趣。你会挑战他吗？

source: If elected, what will you do to get the student and Negro riots in this country under control?
zh: 如果当选，您将采取什么措施来控制这个国家的学生和黑人骚乱？

source: What is more important for your campaign -- competing with Nixon in the swing states, or winning over Wallace voters in the south and some northern cities?
zh: 对于您的竞选活动来说，哪一个更重要——与摇摆州的尼克松竞争，还是赢得南部和一些北部城市的华莱士选民？

source: An alarming percentage of union voters are inspired by the aggressively racist rhetoric of George Wallace. What will you do to win this group back to your side?
zh: 令人震惊的比例的工会选民受到乔治·华莱士激进的种族主义言论的鼓舞。你会怎样做才能让这群人重新回到你身边？

source: What can you say to the people of the South to dampen the appeal of George Wallace?
zh: 你能对南方人民说什么来抑制乔治·华莱士的吸引力？

source: After the debacle of the convention in Chicago, are you willing to make a statement condemning the student protestors? Or conversely, one blaming the Chicago police?
zh: 芝加哥大会惨败后，您是否愿意发表声明谴责学生抗议者？或者相反，有人指责芝加哥警方？

source: On the weekend before the election, Lyndon Johnson's peace negotiations have collapsed with the North Vietnamese. Even worse, there are rumors that a Nixon operative has sabotaged the negotiations. Nixon swears to you on his honor that he is innocent. Will you make this an issue over the last two days of the campaign?
zh: 选举前的周末，林登·约翰逊与北越的和平谈判破裂。更糟糕的是，有传言称一名尼克松特工破坏了谈判。尼克松以他的名誉向你发誓他是无辜的。您会在竞选活动的最后两天将此作为一个问题吗？

source: We keep emboldening the enemy in Vietnam with half-measures. We will never win this war unless we escalate it.
zh: 我们不断以半途而废的方式给越南的敌人壮胆。除非我们升级战争，否则我们永远不会赢得这场战争。

source: I'm in no position to comment on the conduct of the war. When I'm President I will do everything in my power to seek peace, but I cannot undermine the current Administration.
zh: 我无法对战争的进行发表评论。当我担任总统时，我将尽一切努力寻求和平，但我不能破坏现任政府。

source: We should stop bombing North Vietnam and attempt to negotiate a peace settlement. In the mean time, we should be putting our troops at risk only when absolutely necessary.
zh: 我们应该停止轰炸北越并尝试通过谈判达成和平解决方案。与此同时，只有在绝对必要的情况下，我们才应该让我们的部队处于危险之中。

source: There has been a total abdication of responsibility in this country over the past five years. The riots in Detroit and Newark are simply the final straw in what we can accept. I will crack down severely on disorder and nominate judges who will overturn atrocious decisions such as Miranda v. Arizona.
zh: 过去五年来，这个国家完全放弃了责任。底特律和纽瓦克的骚乱简直是压垮我们所能接受的最后一根稻草。我将严厉打击骚乱，并提名法官推翻诸如此类的残暴决定 米兰达诉亚利桑那州.

source: Law and order is the primary theme of my campaign. We also need to encourage investment in the ghettoes to ensure a high quality of life and prevent these occurrences.
zh: 法律与秩序是我的活动的主要主题。我们还需要鼓励对贫民窟的投资，以确保高质量的生活并防止此类事件的发生。

source: Our first priority is always to have strong law enforcement. We also need more spending on education, more integration in our schools, and more programs to ensure that blacks can advance in our society after the stain of segregation.
zh: 我们的首要任务始终是有力执法。同时，我们需要增加教育投入，推动学校进一步实现种族融合，并制定更多措施，让黑人在摆脱种族隔离的阴影后，能够在社会中获得发展。

source: If we had peace in Vietnam and more investment in education here at home, we wouldn't be having these riots.
zh: 如果我们在越南实现和平并在国内对教育进行更多投资，我们就不会发生这些骚乱。

source: We can afford to lose the South if we can win in the North. I will campaign elsewhere in the country and ignore racial issues as much as possible.
zh: 如果我们能在北方获胜，我们就可以承受失去南方的损失。我将在全国其他地方竞选，并尽可能忽视种族问题。

source: By staking a moderate stance on racial issues, I will win a national majority.
zh: 通过在种族问题上采取温和立场，我将赢得全国多数席位。

source: I will make it a point to disavow racial divisiveness as I travel, lest there be any doubt of my stance. We can solidly defeat Nixon and lock Wallace outside of the South and win a mandate for real governance.
zh: 我将在旅行时强调否认种族分歧，以免我的立场受到任何怀疑。我们可以坚定地击败尼克松并将华莱士锁定在南方之外，并赢得真正治理的授权。

source: For two decades I have fought for organized labor and supported the Civil Rights movement. I will focus heavily on my biography as I travel.
zh: 二十年来，我一直为有组织的劳工而奋斗并支持民权运动。当我旅行时，我会重点关注我的传记。

source: I will reaffirm my support for the Great Society and pledge to do everything in my power to end the Vietnam War.
zh: 我将重申对伟大社会的支持，并承诺尽一切努力结束越南战争。

source: The Johnson Administration has done a lot of good things for this country. I will continue his policies as President.
zh: 约翰逊政府为这个国家做了很多好事。作为总统，我将继续执行他的政策。

source: First and foremost, I will end the war in Vietnam by any means necessary. Beyond that I will support the AFL-CIO and otherwise bear the standard for liberalism in this country.
zh: 首先也是最重要的，我将通过任何必要的手段结束越南战争。除此之外，我将支持美国劳工联合会-产联，并在其他方面承担这个国家自由主义的标准。

source: I will tactfully criticize the police overreaction and then pivot towards a promise to end the war in Vietnam.
zh: 我将巧妙地批评警方的过度反应，然后转向承诺结束越南战争。

source: It is not worth addressing the violence outside. I will make a general pledge for law and order and focus my speech on the trials of the working man.
zh: 不值得解决外面的暴力问题。我将对法律与秩序做出总体承诺，并将我的演讲重点放在工人的考验上。

source: I will remind the American people that we stand at a critical juncture in the Civil Rights movement, pledge my full support, and also pledge to end the violence in the streets.
zh: 我将提醒美国人民，我们正处于民权运动的关键时刻，承诺全力支持，并承诺结束街头暴力。

source: My speech will hinge on a defense of liberalism and on the strong economy. I will call for a truce in Vietnam and for a truce on the racial issues in our country.
zh: 我的演讲将取决于对自由主义和强劲经济的捍卫。我将呼吁在越南停火，并在我国的种族问题上停火。

source: Without Texas we are done in this election. I will clearly state my disagreement with Wallace, but we should focus on other issues for the most part.
zh: 没有得克萨斯州，我们这次选举就完了。我将明确表达我与华莱士的不同意见，但我们应该主要关注其他问题。

source: We need to remind union workers at every opportunity that Mr. Wallace is anti-union and regressive on every economic issue of the day.
zh: 我们需要利用一切机会提醒工会工人，华莱士先生在当今的每个经济问题上都是反工会和倒退的。

source: Let's let the AFL-CIO campaign amongst the unions. I will focus on winning the anti-war voters back to our side, and I will reaffirm my commitment to Civil Rights so we can win the minority vote.
zh: 让我们在工会中开展 AFL-CIO 运动。我将集中精力赢得反战选民回到我们这边，我将重申我对民权的承诺，以便我们能够赢得少数派选票。

source: The debates in 1960 were an anomaly. If Nixon has no interest this time, I'm fine with that.
zh: 1960 年的辩论是一种反常现象。如果尼克松这次没有兴趣，我也没关系。

source: This is a real opening for us. I will challenge Nixon on this issue relentlessly.
zh: 这对我们来说是一个真正的机会。我将在这个问题上不懈地挑战尼克松。

source: I fully blame the protestors for what happened. Their goal from day one was to spur a violent confrontation and disrupt the convention.
zh: 我将所发生的一切归咎于抗议者。从第一天起，他们的目标就是引发暴力对抗并破坏大会。

source: What we saw in Chicago was a police riot, pure and simple.
zh: 我们在芝加哥看到的是一场警察骚乱，纯粹而简单。

source: I think there's a lot of blame for both sides. Surely we can all agree that violence cannot be condoned, whatever the source.
zh: 我认为双方都有很多责任。当然，我们都同意，无论暴力来源如何，都不能纵容。

source: I won't be making any statements about Chicago in my campaign. We should forget this as soon as possible and move on to the issues affecting our country.
zh: 我不会在竞选中发表任何有关芝加哥的声明。我们应该尽快忘记这一点，并转向影响我们国家的问题。

source: We have no idea if Nixon was involved in this or not. I won't cheapen the outcome of this election and risk my own reputation with flimsy innuendo.
zh: 我们不知道尼克松是否参与其中。我不会用脆弱的暗示来贬低这次选举的结果，并拿自己的声誉冒险。

source: This is bordering on treason. The American people deserve to hear about this.
zh: 这近乎叛国。美国人民应该听到这个消息。

source: Wallace is trying to throw the election to Nixon. How anyone could believe he's still a Democrat is beyond me.
zh: 华莱士正试图将选举投给尼克松。我无法理解怎么会有人相信他仍然是民主党人。

source: My policies will work better at cracking down on unlawfulness, because I'm actually going to address the root issues that have caused this recent trouble.
zh: 我的政策将更好地打击非法行为，因为我实际上要解决导致最近麻烦的根本问题。

source: I'm more worried about Nixon than Wallace. We need to focus on winning Ohio, Missouri, Illinois, and California if we're gonna win.
zh: 与华莱士相比，我更担心尼克松。如果我们要获胜，我们需要专注于赢得俄亥俄州、密苏里州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州。

source: Nixon is our main opponent in key states, such as Ohio, Illinois, and California. We must focus on campaigning against him in these key states, or else, god forbid, Wallace actually deadlocks the Electoral College.
zh: 尼克松是我们在关键州的主要对手，例如俄亥俄州、伊利诺伊州和加利福尼亚州。我们必须集中精力在这些关键州开展针对他的竞选活动，否则，上帝保佑，华莱士实际上会使选举人团陷入僵局。

source: We shall certianly be campaigning in the South to some extent. We can't just concede the entire region to Wallace. Plus, we must eat into the small, but potentially decisive support he has recieved in some northern cities.
zh: 我们肯定会在某种程度上在南方开展竞选活动。我们不能将整个地区让给华莱士。另外，我们必须蚕食他在一些北方城市获得的虽小但可能具有决定性的支持。

source: Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall, but elsewhere your speech is well-received.
zh: 会议厅里欢呼声和嘲笑声交织在一起，但在其他地方，你的演讲很受欢迎。

source: The riots outside of the convention hall are the eight-hundred pound gorilla in the room. You can't just ignore them.
zh: 会议厅外的骚乱是房间里的八百磅大猩猩。你不能忽视它们。

source: Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall. Observers are surprised by your spotlight on law and order, although the speech is well-received.
zh: 会议厅里欢呼声和嘲笑声交织在一起。尽管您的演讲很受欢迎，但观察人士对您对法律与秩序的关注感到惊讶。

source: This isn't bad, but it completely ignores the issue of Vietnam and does nothing to rebuke the notion that you will continue Johnson's policies there.
zh: 这还不错，但它完全忽略了越南问题，并且没有任何反驳你将继续在那里执行约翰逊政策的观念。

source: This is a good theme to carry through with on your campaign.
zh: 这是一个很好的主题，适合在您的活动中贯彻。

source: You realize Johnson quit because of his massive unpopularity, right? Pledging to continue his policies is not the best way to sell yourself this fall.
zh: 你意识到约翰逊退出是因为他非常不受欢迎，对吗？承诺继续执行他的政策并不是今年秋天推销自己的最佳方式。

source: Uniting your coalition is the first step towards getting yourself back into the race.
zh: 团结你的联盟是让你自己重返竞选的第一步。

source: It's a divisive issue, but on the balance Americans don't want to hear about plans to escalate the Vietnam War.
zh: 这是一个有分歧的问题，但总的来说，美国人不想听到升级越南战争的计划。

source: This is an acceptable answer to assuage Johnson and the Democratic establishment, but you’ve done nothing to win over disaffected doves.
zh: 这是安抚约翰逊和民主党建制派的一个可以接受的答案，但你没有采取任何措施来赢得心怀不满的鸽派人士的支持。

source: This looks to be a real turning point in your campaign. Your call for a bombing halt undercuts the argument that you are a stooge for LBJ, and it's definitely helping you bring the anti-war vote back.
zh: 这看起来是你的竞选活动中真正的转折点。你对停止轰炸的呼吁削弱了你是林登·约翰逊傀儡的论点，而且它肯定会帮助你恢复反战投票。

source: There is no denying that this answer helps you with the anti-war crowd, but it also exposes you to a lot of attacks.
zh: 不可否认，这个答案对你与反战人群有帮助，但它也让你面临很多攻击。

source: This is more extreme than what most people expect to hear from you. There are rumblings of discontent from black voters that you are selling them out.
zh: 这比大多数人期望从您那里听到的更加极端。黑人选民抱怨你出卖了他们。

source: This is an answer is that really is in tune with the country. However, liberals and blacks notice your evasiveness about civil rights.
zh: 这是一个真正符合国家要求的答案。然而，自由主义者和黑人注意到你对民权的回避。

source: Great answer. This addresses the concerns of law and order moderates and the Democratic base.
zh: 很好的答案。这解决了法律与秩序温和派和民主党基础的担忧。

source: This is a good, liberal answer but it might be a bridge too far in the climate of 1968.
zh: 这是一个很好的、自由主义的答案，但在 1968 年的气候下，它可能是一座太过遥远的桥梁。

source: Why are you attacking Medicare? This is a policy that is popular and something you have long backed.
zh: 你为什么攻击联邦医疗保险？这是一项很受欢迎的政策，也是你们长期以来支持的政策。

source: This is the best answer for the situation. It was the presumed answer though, so it has affected the polls minimally.
zh: 这是针对这种情况的最佳答案。不过，这是假定的答案，因此它对民意调查的影响微乎其微。

source: This is a good response, but you’re imitating Nixon and diminishing the booming economy of the Democrats, which deflates your core supporters.
zh: 这是一个很好的回应，但你正在模仿尼克松并削弱民主党蓬勃发展的经济，这让你的核心支持者感到沮丧。

source: Your embrace of the economy satisfies party bosses and brings the left back in line. At the same time, you lose support among independents as it ties yourself too close to the unpopular Johnson.
zh: 你对经济的支持让党的老板们感到满意，并使左翼重新站稳脚跟。同时，您会失去独立人士的支持，因为这将您与不受欢迎的人联系得太近约翰逊。

source: Economists agree that you have staked out a position on the liberal fringe of the economic debate. Although, your liberal economics and aversion to Vietnam helps as much it hurts, stabilizing the polls.
zh: 经济学家一致认为，您在经济辩论的自由主义边缘表明了立场。尽管如此，你的自由主义经济和对越南的厌恶也起到了一定作用，稳定了民意调查。

source: This is a good answer to win over white moderates, but it’s a disappointing answer to your party, especially blacks and liberals.
zh: 对于赢得白人温和派来说，这是一个很好的答案，但对于你的政党，尤其是黑人和自由派来说，这是一个令人失望的答案。

source: Good answer. This appeals to your base, which will lead to an increased liberal and black turnout. However, you’ve alarmed and lost moderates with your statements.
zh: 很好的答案。这对你的基础很有吸引力，这将导致自由派和黑人投票率的增加。然而，你的言论让温和派感到震惊并失去了支持者。

source: It’s valuable to stick by your morals, but America isn’t clamoring for aggressive integration.
zh: 坚持道德是很有价值的，但美国并没有大声疾呼积极的一体化。

source: Why would you not want to debate Nixon? He has an awkward, sometimes surly personality and you would surely look good in comparison.
zh: 为什么你不想辩论尼克松？他性格笨拙，有时甚至脾气暴躁，相比之下你肯定会看起来不错。

source: Nixon refuses to debate you, and most of the voters know it. This will definitely hurt him at the polls.
zh: 尼克松拒绝与你辩论，大多数选民都知道这一点。这肯定会在民意调查中伤害他。

source: After cajoling Nixon into a debate, you have absolutely trounced him. This could be a real turning point in your campaign, which started out looking so hopeless.
zh: 在哄骗尼克松进行辩论后，你已经彻底击败了他。这可能是你的竞选活动中真正的转折点，一开始看起来毫无希望。

source: Nixon agreed to debate you, but unfortunately he did not repeat his 1960 missteps. The inconclusive outcome does little to change the overall picture of the campaign.
zh: 尼克松同意和你辩论，但不幸的是他没有重蹈1960年的覆辙。不确定的结果对改变竞选的整体情况几乎没有作用。

source: You really can't win by choosing a side in the Chicago mayhem. Just move along and find other things to talk about.
zh: 在芝加哥的混乱中，你真的无法通过选择一方获胜。继续前进并找到其他可以谈论的事情。

source: It’s the best answer for the events that transpired in Chicago, but nobody is swayed by your rebuke of both sides.
zh: 这是对芝加哥发生的事件的最佳答案，但没有人会因为你对双方的谴责而动摇。

source: Total avoidance of the subject doesn’t do you any favors, although most Americans quickly move on from the situation.
zh: 完全回避这个话题对你没有任何好处，尽管大多数美国人很快就摆脱了这种情况。

source: This is a great answer if you want to lose the election.
zh: 如果您想输掉选举，这是一个很好的答案。

source: This plays towards moderate voters, but turns off the liberals of the Democratic party. You’ve deprived the base of their previous enthusiasm by being too cautious.
zh: 这对温和派选民有利，但却让民主党的自由派望而却步。你因为过于谨慎而剥夺了他们之前的热情。

source: Democratic moderates rejoice at your words, while the liberals fume and declare you no better than Nixon.
zh: 民主党温和派对你的话感到高兴，而自由派则愤怒并宣称你并不比尼克松更好。

source: Busing is unpopular, but you’ve pleased dedicated activists and grassroot supporters, who dedicate themselves into organizing and campaigning. Largely, your support has not changed.
zh: 公交车不受欢迎，但你让专注的活动家和草根支持者感到高兴，他们致力于组织和竞选活动。很大程度上，您的支持没有改变。

source: You’ve been fighting for civil rights your entire life, and now in a critical moment, you’re against it? Anyways, Democrats have revolted against you.
zh: 你毕生都在争取民权，如今到了关键关头，却反过来反对它？总之，民主党人已经纷纷倒戈。

source: Your response is a little cautious, so no damage will occur. However, no benefit will come from it also.
zh: 你的反应有点谨慎，所以不会发生任何损害。然而，它也不会带来任何好处。

source: The majority of white voters do not place police brutality as the cause of the long, hot summer. In terms of tradeoff, youth and black voters will turn out heavily for this fall.
zh: 大多数白人选民并不认为警察的暴行是造成漫长炎热夏季的原因。就权衡而言，今年秋天年轻人和黑人选民将大量投票。

source: Perhaps the media should stop asking you questions about Dr. King and instead your role in Nixon’s presidential transition.
zh: 也许媒体应该停止问你有关金博士的问题，而应该问你在尼克松总统过渡中的角色。

source: This is the standard, safe response.
zh: 这是标准的安全响应。

source: Scoring political points using Dr. King’s death is tone deaf, which negates any potential support you could have gained. However, many are animated by your speech, which prevents any slippage in the polls.
zh: 利用金博士的死来获得政治分数是无知的，这会否定你可能获得的任何潜在支持。然而，许多人都对你的演讲感到兴奋，这防止了民意调查出现任何下滑。

source: This was probably the worst answer you could give. You simultaneously anger Democrats and Negroes, and appear as a far-right extremist.
