zh: 这可能是您能给出的最糟糕的答案。你同时激怒了民主党人和黑人，并以极右极端分子的形象出现。

source: This is the same answer your opposition has.
zh: 这与你的反对派的答案相同。

source: It’s the expected reply, so nothing really changes on the national stage.
zh: 这是预期的答复，因此国家舞台上没有任何真正的变化。

source: What were you thinking with this answer? You are the anti-war candidate and your rejection of detente has terrified doves about your position on Vietnam.
zh: 你对这个答案有什么想法？你是反战候选人，你对缓和的拒绝让鸽派对你在越南问题上的立场感到恐惧。

source: This is the more hawkish and cautious response.
zh: 这是更为鹰派和谨慎的回应。

source: You’ve affirmed your typical, realistic, but dovish stance.
zh: 你已经确认了你典型的、现实的、但鸽派的立场。

source: Incredibly idealistic, but it’s brought cheers from doves and the New Left.
zh: 令人难以置信的理想主义，但却带来了鸽派和新左派的欢呼。

source: When your advisors explained that you needed to be your own man and detach yourself from the unpopular Johnson, this is not what they were thinking.
zh: 当你的顾问解释说你需要做自己的人并让自己脱离不受欢迎的约翰逊时，他们并不是这么想的。

source: You sound suspiciously similar to Nixon. In fact, the black community has decried your new turn towards black capitalism.
zh: 你听起来与尼克松非常相似。事实上，黑人社区已经谴责了你们对黑人资本主义的新转变。

source: This was probably the best answer, as you manage to tackle the concerns of your big tent of voters.
zh: 这可能是最好的答案，因为您设法解决了一大群选民的担忧。

source: Lyndon calls you to inform that you have his complete support, securing the base. But a portion of moderates are spooked by your commitment to expanding the Great Society.
zh: 林登打电话给你，通知你得到他的全力支持，确保基地安全。但部分温和派对您扩大伟大社会的承诺感到震惊。

source: Major gains have been achieved in Texas, but voters sense your hesitancy towards Wallace. Polls across the nation have only been affected slightly.
zh: 得克萨斯州取得了重大进展，但选民感觉到您对华莱士犹豫不决。全国民意调查仅受到轻微影响。

source: Your offensive against Wallace nets you union boys, who are constantly reminded of “Wallace-land” and it's destitute working conditions.
zh: 你对华莱士的进攻让你的工会男孩们陷入困境，他们不断地提醒着“华莱士-土地”及其贫困的工作条件。

source: AFL-CIO leaders flex their power, cajoling Wallace-friendly union men. Your personal campaign scores big in liberal states, but less so in other areas.
zh: AFL-CIO 领导人展示他们的权力，哄骗华莱士友好的工会人员。你的个人竞选活动在自由主义国家得分很高，但在其他领域得分较低。

source: Many working-class Americans are convinced and impressed by the eloquence of your speech. This will definitely help you.
zh: 您雄辩的演讲令许多美国工人阶级信服并印象深刻。这绝对会对你有帮助。

source: Bad answer. Americans are not seeking an escalation of the war, and your constituents feel betrayed by your abrupt change towards Vietnam.
zh: 错误的答案。美国人并不寻求战争升级，而你们对越南态度的突然改变让你们的选民感到背叛。

source: Nothing you just said will be acceptable to the anti-war crowd. To make matters worse, data shows you have lost support.
zh: 你刚才所说的一切都不会被反战人群所接受。更糟糕的是，数据显示你已经失去了支持。

source: This is the best answer. Of course, it estranges the extreme doves, but most doves are in lockstep with your campaign. As a bonus, you coax a few moderates into supporting you.
zh: 这是最好的答案。当然，这会疏远极端的鸽派人士，但大多数鸽派人士都与你的竞选活动保持一致。作为奖励，你还可以说服一些温和派人士支持你。

source: In climate of ‘68, this is unreasonably dovish. And it’s generated easy attacks that you are weak against Communism, and at worst, a crypto-Communist.
zh: 在 68 年的气候下，这是不合理的鸽派。它很容易引发攻击，认为你对共产主义很弱，最坏的情况是，你是一个加密共产主义者。

source: The nation is not in the mood for more kids coming home in caskets.
zh: 这个国家没有心情让更多的孩子躺在棺材里回家。

source: This position is popular within your party, and Lyndon himself doesn’t disagree with it.
zh: 这个立场在你们党内很受欢迎，林登本人并不反对。

source: Way to flex foreign policy. With rumors of ongoing peace talks, this might legitimately become reality. You’ve inspired hope amongst the American people with your brave, idealistic stance.
zh: 灵活外交政策的方式。随着和平谈判正在进行的传言，这可能合法地成为现实。您以勇敢、理想主义的立场激发了美国人民的希望。

source: Winning over the anti-war crowd is crucial, but you’ve swung too far and alienated the mainstream population.
zh: 赢得反战人群的支持至关重要，但你太过分了，疏远了主流人群。

source: Pundits are surprised by your harsh tone towards the Reds, but it’s dissolved the constant claims relating you to Communism. It’s clear you’re no pushover.
zh: 专家们对你对红军的严厉语气感到惊讶，但这消除了有关你与共产主义的不断主张。很明显，你不是一个容易被打败的人。

source: This is the sensible answer that has an appeal to everyone. Well, everyone but the kooks.
zh: 这是对每个人都有吸引力的明智答案。好吧，除了怪人之外的所有人。

source: This is a great answer that reminds the nation of the fruitless endeavor that is Vietnam.
zh: 这是一个很好的答案，提醒全国人民越南的徒劳努力。

source: Your position is mocked for being by defense hawks for being delusional, and attacked by conservatives for being a “useful idiot.” But you’ve resonated with the country, who are tired of the war.
zh: 你的立场被国防鹰派嘲笑为妄想，并被保守派攻击为“有用的白痴”。但你引起了厌倦战争的国家的共鸣。

source: Observers believe that Israel launched a surprise attack first and question your logic. You’ve also gone against Johnson and the State Department on this issue.
zh: 观察家认为是以色列先发动突然袭击并质疑你的逻辑。您还在这个问题上反对约翰逊和国务院。

source: This is a good, broad answer that doesn’t alienate anyone.
zh: 这是一个很好、广泛的答案，不会疏远任何人。

source: This is a surprising anti-Israel answer coming from you, that hurts you marginally.
zh: 这是您提出的令人惊讶的反以色列答案，这对您造成了轻微的伤害。

source: You contradict your previous statements and earn the ire of American Jews.
zh: 你与之前的陈述相矛盾，并引起了美国犹太人的愤怒。

source: Democrats are stunned by your complete reversal, which won’t bode well for you this November.
zh: 民主党人对你的完全逆转感到震惊，这对今年 11 月的你来说不是好兆头。

source: Wasteful programs? Needless to say, the Democratic party is furious and angry calls fill up your offices.
zh: 浪费的公共项目？不用说，民主党人怒不可遏，抗议电话快把你的办公室打爆了。

source: This is the exact answer Johnson, the party, and the base was looking for.
zh: 这就是政党和基地正在寻找的确切答案约翰逊。

source: Being consistent is unquestionably important, but the extensive federal expansions you’re suggesting is frowned upon by most Americans.
zh: 保持一致无疑很重要，但您所建议的大规模联邦扩张遭到大多数美国人的反对。

source: You have taken the high road on this key issue, but it doesn't change the fact that peace talks have stalled. Sit down and watch the returns, and pray that you've done enough to pull out what would be an amazing comeback.
zh: 你们在这个关键问题上采取了强硬态度，但这并不能改变和平谈判陷入僵局的事实。坐下来观看选举结果，并祈祷你已经做了足够的努力来实现令人惊奇的东山再起。

source: The election closes in chaos. Peace talks collapse, you accuse Nixon, Nixon accuses the Democrats of bugging his plane, and the upshot is mass confusion and anger among the voters. Good luck tonight!
zh: 选举在混乱中结束。和谈破裂，你指责尼克松，尼克松指责民主党窃听他的飞机，结果是选民中的大规模混乱和愤怒。祝今晚好运！

source: As word gets around that Nixon probably sabotaged the Vietnam peace negotiations, you are the clear beneficiary of an 11th hour surge in the polls. Will it be enough to hand you a victory tonight?
zh: 随着尼克松可能破坏越南和平谈判的消息传开，您显然是第 11 小时民意调查激增的受益者。今晚这足以让你取得胜利吗？

source: The AFL-CIO is one of your fiercest supporters and you’re slamming them? They’ve retracted their endorsement of you and union masses have swapped to Wallace.
zh: AFL-CIO 是您最激烈的支持者之一，而您却在猛烈抨击他们？他们撤回了对你的支持，工会群众也转向了华莱士。

source: Wow. In one stroke, you outrage every type of union member. Even prominent union leaders are now backing Wallace rather than you.
zh: 哇。你一下子就激怒了所有类型的工会成员。即使是著名的工会领导人现在也支持华莱士而不是你。

source: Labor is ecstatic, and unions start winning back Wallace supporters. Union states are especially delighted by your response.
zh: 工党欣喜若狂，工会开始赢回华莱士支持者。联盟各州对您的回应感到特别高兴。

source: Hubert Humphrey opposing welfare? Multiple advisors wonder if they woke up in the wrong timeline.
zh: 休伯特汉弗莱反对福利？多名顾问怀疑自己是否在错误的时间线醒来。

source: Both your pessimism and the lack of support towards welfare, programs you’ve always fought for, worry core supporters.
zh: 你的悲观情绪和对你一直为之奋斗的福利项目缺乏支持，让核心支持者感到担忧。

source: You’ve shifted the conversation to regulations and the economy, but Americans across the political spectrum are concerned about the environment.
zh: 您已将话题转向法规和经济，但各个政治派别的美国人都关心环境。

source: The Democratic base wants something more assertive on the environment.
zh: 民主党基地希望在环境问题上采取更加自信的措施。

source: Good move. Promising further regulation to protect the environment pleases the base.
zh: 好举措。承诺进一步监管以保护环境令基层感到高兴。

source: Federal tyranny? And what were you saying about Brown v. Board of Education?
zh: 联邦暴政？你在说什么 布朗诉教育委员会案?

source: The Warren Court is unpopular overall, but this clashes with many liberal supporters who have a positive view of the Court.
zh: 沃伦法院总体上不受欢迎，但这与许多对法院持积极看法的自由派支持者发生冲突。

source: This is a weak answer to liberals, but appeals strongly to moderates.
zh: 这对自由主义者来说是一个软弱的答案，但对温和派却有着强烈的吸引力。

source: Blacks and liberals are thrilled, but moderates dislike your approval and promise to continue the policies of the Warren Court.
zh: 黑人和自由主义者很兴奋，但温和派不喜欢你的批准并承诺继续执行沃伦法院的政策。

source: Abortion is a contentious issue and your view is unnecessarily conservative. Feminists, led by the National Organization for Women, are enraged and protests become common at your rallies.
zh: 堕胎是一个有争议的问题，您的观点过于保守。以全国妇女组织为首的女权主义者被激怒了，抗议活动在你们的集会上变得司空见惯。

source: Conservative Democrats love this, but it turns off your more liberal supporters.
zh: 保守的民主党人喜欢这个，但它会让你更自由的支持者感到厌烦。

source: This is a liberal answer that still engages moderates. The negative? Conservative Democrats are upset by the answer.
zh: 这是一个仍然吸引温和派的自由主义答案。负面的？保守民主党人对这个答案感到不安。

source: This is too liberal for many in your party to stomach.
zh: 这对你们党内的许多人来说太自由了，难以接受。

source: Many of your supporters, especially the Jewish community, disagree. The New Left have capitalized, fearmongering that it’s the end for separation of church and state based on your rhetoric.
zh: 你的许多支持者，尤其是犹太社区，不同意。新左派利用了你的言论，散布恐惧，认为政教分离的终结。

source: Not the worst answer, but still a bad one. Your supporters are disturbed by enforcing religion on American children through the state.
zh: 这不是最糟糕的答案，但仍然是一个糟糕的答案。你的支持者对通过国家向美国儿童强制推行宗教感到不安。

source: This is a middle-ground answer that doesn’t rebuff any voters.
zh: 这是一个中间立场的答案，不会拒绝任何选民。

source: To most Americans, this position is a bit out of the mainstream.
zh: 对于大多数美国人来说，这个立场有点脱离主流。

source: Surprisingly, your disastrous answer has flown under the radar. Your advisors are incredibly relieved and set up on a emergency meeting to prevent you from spouting further nonsense.
zh: 令人惊讶的是，你的灾难性答案已经被忽视了。你的顾问们松了一口气，并召开了一次紧急会议，以防止你再胡言乱语。

source: This only paints you as indecisive towards voters. Even Nixon is more insistent, wanting to retain the program.
zh: 这只会让你显得对选民优柔寡断。甚至尼克松也更加坚持，想要保留该计划。

source: It’s good to stick by your proposals and policies.
zh: 坚持你的建议和政策是件好事。

source: Negroes take offense to your response, viewing it as parroting Nixon and worse, Wallace. Even right-wing whites admit that you echo Wallace.
zh: 黑人对你的回应感到冒犯，认为这是鹦鹉学舌尼克松，更糟糕的是，华莱士。即使是右翼白人也承认你赞同华莱士。

source: White voters are content, but blacks demand more from the Democrats, due to the poverty in their urban communities.
zh: 白人选民感到满意，但由于城市社区的贫困，黑人对民主党的要求更高。

source: You defend the administration’s actions, which reassures African-Americans but frustrates white Americans who believe such measures to be excessive.
zh: 你为政府的行动辩护，这让非裔美国人放心，但让美国白人感到沮丧，他们认为这些措施太过分了。

source: Very liberal of you. You’ve won the absolute loyalty of the Negro community, and also lost many white voters. But you’ve exchanged them equally, so polls haven’t moved.
zh: 你非常自由。你们赢得了黑人群体的绝对忠诚，但也失去了许多白人选民。但你们平等地交换了它们，所以民意调查没有发生变化。

source: This is very out of touch with the current mood of America. On the bright side, you do receive a boost in Florida from Cuban-Americans.
zh: 这与美国当前的情绪非常脱节。从好的方面来说，你确实从古巴裔美国人那里得到了佛罗里达州的提升。

source: Much of the party, LBJ, moderates, and conservative Democrats are extremely elated. It proves to the country you’re not a radical left-wing, communist sympathizer.
zh: 党内的大部分人、林登·约翰逊、温和派和保守的民主党人都非常高兴。这向全国证明你不是激进的左翼共产主义同情者。

source: This has a certain appeal to your wide coalition. You backup Johnson and simultaneously throw a bone to the left.
zh: 这对你们的广泛联盟有一定的吸引力。你备份约翰逊，同时向左侧扔一根骨头。

source: This legitimizes your detractors and right-wing claims that you are weak on Communism.
zh: 这使你的批评者和右翼声称你在共产主义方面软弱的说法合法化。

source: Tough words, Hubert. Radical student organizations disavow you, but working-class and suburban Americans are appreciative towards your law and order stance.
zh: 言辞难听，休伯特。激进的学生组织否认你，但美国工人阶级和郊区的人对你的法律与秩序立场表示赞赏。

source: Nice rant, but it’s quite extreme and has horrified Democrats.
zh: 不错的咆哮，但它相当极端，让民主党人感到震惊。

source: This is a tad sympathetic to the protestors, but it gets the job done. But moderates, focused on the chaos, are bothered by your acknowledgment of student complaints.
zh: 这有点同情抗议者，但它完成了工作。但关注混乱的温和派对你承认学生的投诉感到不安。

source: Johnson is unpopular, but he’s the most powerful mover and shaker within the party. Criticizing his governance just earned you his wrath.
zh: 约翰逊不受欢迎，但他是党内最有影响力的人物。批评他的治理只会招致他的愤怒。

source: Labor and unions disagree.
zh: 劳工和工会不同意。

source: This is a good answer. You manage to mollify LBJ and also soothe unions who are anxious about the effect these agreements have.
zh: 这是一个很好的答案。您设法安抚林登·约翰逊，并安抚对这些协议的影响感到焦虑的工会。

source: Americans generally like the pill.
zh: 美国人普遍喜欢避孕药。

source: The pill is not the biggest issue this election.
zh: 避孕药并不是这次选举的最大问题。

source: While true, this is the exact opposite of what Americans believe how the war is going and doesn’t endear you to anti-war voters.
zh: 虽然这是事实，但这与美国人对战争进展的看法完全相反，并且不会让反战选民喜欢你。

source: You’ve discredited the administration you served under, but the President hasn’t acted against you. The anti-war crowd welcomes you, and you shake off claims that you are merely a puppet for Johnson.
zh: 你已经败坏了你所服务的政府的声誉，但总统并没有对你采取行动。反战人群欢迎你，你也摆脱了“你只是约翰逊傀儡”的说法。

source: You’ve justified President Johnson’s handling of Vietnam and have his thanks, but it pushes away doves - they despise Jumbo.
zh: 你已经证明了总统约翰逊对越南的处理是合理的，并得到了他的感谢，但这却赶走了鸽派 - 他们鄙视 Jumbo。

source: Voters want more than just gloating with hindsight.
zh: 选民想要的不仅仅是事后的幸灾乐祸。

source: A plurality of your advisors just resigned. The ones staying on are frankly just astonished by how stupid you are.
zh: 您的多名顾问刚刚辞职。坦率地说，留下来的人只是对你的愚蠢感到惊讶。

source: Blacks wish for a comment, anything about police brutality from you. For whites, this is a great answer, showing that you aren’t just all talk about law and order.
zh: 黑人希望您发表评论，任何有关警察暴行的事情。对于白人来说，这是一个很好的答案，表明你们不仅仅是在谈论法律与秩序。

source: Negroes vigorously applaud you, but most whites do not believe police overreacted when quelling the riots.
zh: 黑人为你大力鼓掌，但大多数白人不相信警察在平息骚乱时反应过度。

source: Are you trying to lose the election?
zh: 你想输掉选举吗？

source: This is a moderate answer, being both patriotic and appeases college students.
zh: 这是一个温和的答案，既爱国又安抚大学生。

source: Students and radicals agree with you. Nobody else does, resulting in you being firmly outside the mainstream.
zh: 学生和激进分子同意你的观点。没有其他人这样做，导致你坚定地处于主流之外。

source: Outside of a few students and radicals, nobody agrees with your viewpoint.
zh: 除了少数学生和激进分子之外，没有人同意你的观点。

source: This gives the impression that you don’t really care about the environment at all.
zh: 这给人的印象是您根本不关心环境。

source: Unions and working-class voters adore your answer, but liberal environmentalists see it as toothless.
zh: 工会和工人阶级选民喜欢你的答案，但自由环保主义者认为它毫无作用。

source: This is a decent, liberal answer except that it leaves you open for attacks: conservatives accuse you of being a tree hugging hippie.
zh: 这是一个体面的、自由主义的答案，只是它让你容易受到攻击：保守派指责你是一个拥抱树的嬉皮士。

source: What? The voters that you need detest making interracial marriage illegal.
zh: 什么？你需要的选民厌恶将异族通婚定为非法。

source: Making the subject about states rights is possibly the worst way to oppose it as a Democrat.
zh: 以州权利为主题可能是作为民主党人反对它的最糟糕的方式。

source: Probably the best answer. The nation doesn't like interracial marriage, but doesn’t want laws pertaining to its legality.
zh: 可能是最好的答案。这个国家不喜欢异族婚姻，但也不想要有关其合法性的法律。

source: Your response leans conservative, hurting approval from liberals, but does great for many moderates.
zh: 你的回应偏保守，损害了自由派的认可，但对许多温和派来说却很有好处。

source: Poor citizens love it, but moderates and conservatives are less amused.
zh: 穷人喜欢它，但温和派和保守派就不那么好笑了。

source: Attempting to receive a endorsement from The National Review isn’t the best strategy, Hubert.
zh: 尝试获得来自的认可 国家评论 不是最好的策略，休伯特。

source: Taking a page out of George Wallace’s book, eh? To say the least, it didn’t go well.
zh: 从乔治·华莱士的书中取出一页，嗯？至少可以说，进展并不顺利。

source: Hubert Humphrey, ready to lead the country!
zh: 休伯特汉弗莱，准备好领导国家了！

source: This is true, and binds yourself to the strong economy and the slain President.
zh: 这是真的，并将您与强劲的经济和被杀的总统联系在一起。

source: You are going to have a very hard time winning this election if you agree with everything LBJ has done in Vietnam.
zh: 如果您同意林登·约翰逊在越南所做的一切，那么您将很难赢得这次选举。

source: Voters, particularly doves, notice your clear anti-war stance. Unfortunately, Lyndon does sabotage you, specifically in Texas.
zh: 选民，特别是鸽派，注意到你明确的反战立场。不幸的是，Lyndon 确实破坏了你，特别是在得克萨斯州中。

source: You’ve demonstrated that you are your own man and not just Johnson’s goon. But campaign operatives report that the Texas Democratic Party is unusually hostile.
zh: 你已经证明了你是你自己的人，而不仅仅是约翰逊的暴徒。但竞选活动人员报告说，得克萨斯州民主党异常敌对。

source: Dump the Hump!
zh: 甩掉驼峰！

source: This is a bad answer. While you do appear tough on communism, it costs you the anti-war movement.
zh: 这是一个糟糕的答案。虽然你确实对共产主义表现得强硬，但它却让你付出了反战运动的代价。

source: Some people talk change, others cause it.
zh: 有些人谈论改变，另一些人则导致改变。

source: The American people disapprove of the war, but they also don’t want communism spreading across Southeast Asia.
zh: 美国人民不赞成战争，但他们也不希望共产主义蔓延到整个东南亚。

source: Are you going to make your next speech about social engineering, states rights, and the anarchy movement?
zh: 您的下一次演讲是否会涉及社会工程、国家权利和无政府主义运动？

source: Decent, moderate response that shares the nation’s views, but it has harmed your reputation within your base.
zh: 体面、温和的回应，与国家观点一致，但它损害了你在基地内的声誉。

source: Probably the correct answer for this minefield. You have to stick up for liberalism nationally.
zh: 可能是这个雷区的正确答案。你必须在全国范围内坚持自由主义。

source: Can you comment on the newly created Head Start program?
zh: 您能否对新创建的 Head Start 计划发表评论？

source: The Head Start program is another product of the out-of-touch, intellectual elite. It's a waste of money.
zh: Head Start 计划是脱离现实的知识精英的另一个产品。这是浪费钱。

source: We need to do anything we can to ensure quality education for our youngsters. Let's see how this program develops and whether it seems to work or not.
zh: 我们需要尽一切努力确保我们的年轻人获得优质教育。让我们看看这个程序是如何开发的以及它是否有效。

source: Programs like Head Start are the only way that we will end poverty in our cities and rural districts. I fought for this program from the beginning and I will support it as President.
zh: 像 Head Start 这样的计划是我们消除城市和农村地区贫困的唯一途径。我从一开始就为这个计划而奋斗，作为总统我将支持它。

source: Lyndon Johnson, in his crude way, swears that he will slit your throat if you oppose his policies on Vietnam while campaigning. Will you risk his wrath and be your own man on the trail?
zh: 林登·约翰逊以他粗鲁的方式发誓，如果你在竞选时反对他的越南政策，他会割断你的喉咙。你愿意冒着他的愤怒的风险，在路上做自己的人吗？

source: Do you believe that the black community in most cities overreacted to the assassination of Martin Luther King this past April?
zh: 您是否认为大多数城市的黑人社区对今年四月马丁·路德·金的暗杀反应过度？

source: The reaction that occurred should terrify any thinking American. Entire neighborhoods were burned and pillaged. They even looted their own storekeepers in many cities.
zh: 所发生的反应应该让任何有思想的美国人感到恐惧。整个街区都被烧毁和掠夺。他们甚至在许多城市抢劫自己的店主。

source: That was a very tough event for many of us to take, no matter what our backgrounds were. I believe that more precautions should have been taken to keep things from getting out of hand, but we must also remember that most Negroes wanted no part of these riots.
zh: 对于我们许多人来说，无论我们的背景如何，这都是一次非常艰难的事件。我认为应该采取更多预防措施来防止事情失控，但我们也必须记住，大多数黑人不想参与这些骚乱。

source: I believe that both the black community and the police overreacted in many areas. First and foremost, we must speak out against violence wherever it may occur -- and against whoever is the source of it.
zh: 我认为黑人社区和警察在许多领域都反应过度。首先也是最重要的一点，我们必须大声疾呼反对暴力，无论暴力发生在哪里，也无论暴力的根源是谁。

source: That's not an entirely relevant question, because I agree with Johnson's stance in Vietnam. We cannot cave in to Communist aggression and maintain our standing in the world.
zh: 这不是一个完全相关的问题，因为我同意约翰逊在越南的立场。我们不能屈服于共产党的侵略并维持我们在世界上的地位。

source: I have no problems opposing the policies of Lyndon Johnson. If he wants to try and sabotage my campaign, we'll just have to live with it.
zh: 我对反对林登·约翰逊的政策没有任何问题。如果他想尝试破坏我的竞选活动，我们就只能忍受了。

source: Johnson is a deeply unpopular President. I don't think his threats are credible here. I will loudly call for peace in Vietnam.
zh: 约翰逊是一位非常不受欢迎的总统。我认为他的威胁在这里不可信。我将大声呼吁越南和平。

source: What will be the overall message of your campaign?
zh: 您的活动的总体信息是什么？

source: What is more important to you -- competing with Nixon in the border states (to help Humphrey) or winning over Humphrey voters in the northern cities (to help Nixon)?
zh: 对你来说哪个更重要——与边境州的尼克松竞争（帮助汉弗莱）还是赢得北部城市的汉弗莱选民（帮助尼克松）？

source: Will you try to compete with Johnson and Humphrey's machine in Texas?
zh: 你会尝试在得克萨斯州中与约翰逊和汉弗莱的机器竞争吗？

source: If there is no majority in the electoral college, what are your goals at the bargaining table?
zh: 如果选举人团没有获得多数席位，您在谈判桌上的目标是什么？

source: I am campaigning on the issue of ending desegregation. That is my appeal and that is the issue I will stick to.
zh: 我正在就结束废除种族隔离问题开展竞选活动。这是我的诉求，也是我将坚持的问题。

source: I'm opposed to desegregation, environmentalism, defeatism, social engineering, busing, declining property values, and unchecked rioting. My candidacy appeals to southerners and northerners alike.
zh: 我反对废除种族隔离、环保主义、失败主义、社会工程、公交车、房产价值下降和不受控制的骚乱。我的候选资格对南方人和北方人都有吸引力。

source: You know, beyond the racial thing I do have other policies. I have worked tirelessly in Alabama on behalf of the poor and downtrodden, and I will do the same as President of the United States.
zh: 你知道，除了种族问题之外，我还有其他政策。我在阿拉巴马州中为穷人和受压迫者不知疲倦地工作，作为美国总统我也会做同样的事情。

source: I am a serious candidate for President of the United States. I will protect law-abiding Americans from social disorder and I will win the war in Vietnam.
zh: 我是美国总统的认真候选人。我将保护守法的美国人免受社会混乱的影响，我将赢得越南战争。

source: Texas should be fertile ground for the George Wallace message. If Humphrey and Johnson get into a rift, I think we've got a real shot in that state. I will try my best to win it.
zh: 得克萨斯州应该是乔治·华莱士消息的沃土。如果汉弗莱和约翰逊出现裂痕，我认为我们在那种状态下有真正的机会。我会尽全力去赢得它。

source: I'm more worried about keeping the rest of the South from going to Nixon. I'm less concerned about Humphrey's chances in Texas.
zh: 我更担心阻止南方其他人去尼克松。我不太关心汉弗莱在得克萨斯州中的机会。

source: I'm just going to run my campaign and whatever happens between those two will happen.
zh: 我只是要开展我的竞选活动，两者之间发生的任何事情都会发生。

source: It looks like Nixon is the favorite, so I'm going to focus most of my efforts on campaigning where he's ahead.
zh: 看起来尼克松是最受欢迎的，所以我将把大部分精力集中在他领先的竞选活动上。

source: Humphrey and the Democrats need to know in the future that they cannot ignore the due concerns of the South and win elections. I will focus on winning potential Humphrey supporters.
zh: 汉弗莱民主党未来需要知道，他们不能忽视南方的应有关切并赢得选举。我将专注于赢得潜在的汉弗莱支持者。

source: I will support whatever candidate agrees to rescind the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and agrees to appoint justices who will overturn Brown v. Board of Education. If no candidate agrees to those conditions, then I will not support either one of them.
zh: 我将支持任何同意废除 1964 年民权法案并同意任命将推翻的法官的候选人 布朗诉教育委员会案。如果没有候选人同意这些条件，那么我不会支持其中任何一个。

source: There's not a dime's worth of difference between the Democrats and Republicans. My goal is to win this election outright.
zh: 民主党和共和党之间没有一毛钱的区别。我的目标是彻底赢得这次选举。

source: Whatever ends up happening on election day, I cannot comment about the aftermath at this point. If that scenario develops I will hear what each side has to say and make a decision at that point.
zh: 无论选举日最终发生什么，我目前无法对后果发表评论。如果出现这种情况，我将听取各方的意见并做出决定。

source: This position is too dovish for the mainstream of the Republican Party. In the future you might do better to take a more moderate stance.
zh: 这个立场对于共和党的主流来说过于鸽派。将来你可能会采取更温和的立场。

source: This is vintage Nixon. You should do well with your appeals to law and order as long as your rhetoric doesn't sound too extreme.
zh: 这是复古的尼克松。只要你的言辞听起来不太极端，你就应该很好地表达你对法律与秩序的诉求。

source: The election closes in chaos. Peace talks collapse, you accuse Nixon, Nixon accuses the Democrats of bugging his plane, and the upshot is mass confusion and anger among the voters. Good luck tonight!
zh: 选举在混乱中结束。和谈破裂，你指责尼克松，尼克松指责民主党窃听他的飞机，结果是选民中的大规模混乱和愤怒。祝今晚好运！

source: Stick to your bread-and-butter appeals. This is red meat for the kind of people who will vote for you this fall.
zh: 坚持你的基本诉求。对于今年秋天投票给你的人来说，这是红肉。

source: This is not what your supporters want to hear out of you.
zh: 这不是你的支持者想从你嘴里听到的。

source: This is anathema to your voting base. They are talking about dumping you now and just voting for Nixon.
zh: 这对你们的投票基础来说是一种诅咒。他们现在正在讨论甩掉你，只是投票给尼克松。

source: It looks like Humphrey has enjoyed a last minute surge in the polls, thanks to a breakthrough in peace negotiations. Will this help cause a deadlock in the electoral college?
zh: 由于和平谈判取得突破，汉弗莱的民调支持率似乎在最后一刻飙升。这会导致选举人团陷入僵局吗？

source: Do you plan to make a strong effort in any of the non-Southern states?
zh: 您是否计划在南方以外的州做出大力努力？

source: My goal is to sweep the South and prevent either candidate from achieving an electoral majority. I will make this region my primary focus.
zh: 我的目标是横扫南方并阻止任何一位候选人获得选举多数。我将把这个地区作为我的主要关注点。

source: I will stick to the states where Richard Nixon is leading, and emphasize my credentials as a law-and-order conservative. If I can keep Nixon below 270, I have a real chance at brokering an end to desegregation after this election.
zh: 我将坚持理查德·尼克松领先的州，并强调我作为法律和秩序保守派的资历。如果我能将尼克松保持在 270 以下，我就有真正的机会在这次选举后促成废除种族隔离。

source: I am a national candidate, and my law-and-order appeal is universal. I will travel into the North and the West and campaign for any voter who is concerned about the future of our country.
zh: 我是一名全国候选人，我对法律和秩序的呼吁是普遍的。我将前往北部和西部，为所有关心我们国家未来的选民竞选。

source: We need to teach the Democrats a lesson this year. I will work tirelessly to pry white northern votes away from Humphrey, so that future candidates on our side know they'd best not trifle with the South.
zh: 今年我们需要给民主党一个教训。我将孜孜不倦地努力从汉弗莱中夺走北方白人的选票，以便我们这一边未来的候选人知道他们最好不要玩弄南方。

source: What can you say to the people of the South to dampen the appeal of Richard Nixon?
zh: 你能对南方人民说什么来抑制理查德·尼克松的吸引力？

source: Richard Nixon is a California yankee and an interloper. He does not deserve the support of a decent southern man.
zh: 理查德·尼克松是一个加利福尼亚州洋基人和闯入者。他不值得一个正派南方人的支持。

source: I have more credibility than Nixon does on the issues of law-and-order. I trust that southerners will see through his empty appeals on this issue.
zh: 在法律和秩序问题上我比尼克松更有可信度。我相信南方人会看穿他在这个问题上的空洞呼吁。

source: I'm more worried about sticking it to Humphrey than I am about Nixon. If it comes down to a negotiated election, I'd rather have Nixon in the driver's seat because I think we can work with him.
zh: 我更担心将其坚持到汉弗莱，而不是尼克松。如果归结为协商选举，我宁愿让尼克松掌舵，因为我认为我们可以与他合作。
